# Everest Siding and Windows

> Family-owned exterior remodeling contractor in the Greater Houston area since 2015: LP SmartSide and James Hardie siding installation and replacement, window replacement, roofing (GAF and Malarkey), covered patios and outdoor living, plus add-on services. Showroom in Tomball, TX. Bills itself as the largest LP SmartSide home remodeler in Texas.

## Key facts
- Address: 11424 Spring Cypress Rd Unit A1, Tomball, TX 77377
- Phone: (832) 334-2528
- Email: info@everestsidingandwindows.com
- Showroom hours: Monday-Friday 9am-5pm, by appointment only
- Founded: 2015; multi-generation, family owned and operated
- Free, no-obligation estimates and consultations
- Pricing: 100% guaranteed pricing with a no-change-order policy (what is quoted is what is paid)
- Lowest bid guaranteed, or a $50 gift card
- Warranty: Everest's own Lifetime Labor Warranty on every project, on top of manufacturer warranties (e.g. LP SmartSide 5/50-year limited)
- Payment: cash, check, all major credit cards, and financing (unsecured home improvement loans, same-day decisions, no early repayment penalty)
- Installers: Everest does not subcontract to untrained crews
- Typical siding replacement: 5 to 12 business days
- Residential focus; light commercial by request

## What Everest does not do
- No siding repairs (installation and full replacement only)
- No sale of materials (not a distributor or supplier)
- Window replacement minimum: 3 windows

## Products and partners
- Siding: LP SmartSide engineered wood, James Hardie (HardiePlank) fiber cement
- Paint: Sherwin-Williams
- Windows: NT Window, MI Windows and Doors, Simonton
- Roofing: GAF (Timberline HDZ), Malarkey (Emerald Pro and Certified Residential Contractor)
- Memberships: NARI (National Association of the Remodeling Industry), Tomball, Cy-Fair and Houston Northwest chambers of commerce

## Service area
Houston, Conroe, Cypress, Hockley, Humble, Huntsville, Jersey Village, Katy, Kingwood, Magnolia, Montgomery, Pinehurst, Richmond, Spring, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Tomball and Willis, TX

## Antimicrobial Coating in Houston, TX
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/antimicrobial-coating-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2026-07-28
Summary: Everest Siding and Windows offers antimicrobial coating in Houston with durable biostatic protection that fights mold mildew and algae with ease.

Antimicrobial Coating in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
Exterior home remodeling projects, such as siding and roof replacement, are some of the highest investments homeowners make in their home. Therefore, it only makes sense to not only use the best materials available on the market, but also ensure they last as long as possible. In order to maximize the longevity and beauty of your home exterior, Everest Siding and Windows offers an Antimicrobial Coating add-on service that provides freshness and combats deterioration and discoloration against mold, mildew and algae.
Our Antimicrobial Coating is a colorless, odorless, invisible shield that creates a covalent bond, with durable bio-static activity, to the surface of a wide variety of exterior substrates. When properly applied, it greatly increases the efficiency as a bacteriostatic, fungistatic and algistatic coating protectant. The antimicrobial coating imparts durable biostatic activity to the surface of a wide variety of substrates. It forms a positively charged layer that molecularly bonds to the treated surface. When a microorganism comes in contact with this layer, the active agent punctures the cell membrane and the electrical charge shocks the cell and physically destroys it.
It provides freshness and combats deterioration and discoloration caused by bacteria, fungi and algae, extending the life of any exterior surface. Stops the growth of mold and mildew.
No hand to Chemical Contact – Zero Residual – No clean up Required! No leaching technology or heavy metals. Safe and harmless to people, pets and the environment.
How Antimicrobial Coatings Work
Prevents premature material deterioration and discoloration
Stops the growth of mold and mildew
Non-toxic and has no VOCs
Safe and harmless to people, pets and the environment
Frequently Asked Questions
What does antimicrobial coating do?
It’s a colorless, odorless, invisible shield that molecularly bonds to your exterior surfaces and stops the growth of mold, mildew, and algae — helping prevent deterioration and discoloration and extending the life of your siding or roof.
Is the coating safe for my family and pets?
Yes. It’s non-toxic with no VOCs, uses no leaching technology or heavy metals, and is safe and harmless to people, pets, and the environment. There’s no chemical contact, no residual, and no cleanup required.
Can I book this on its own?
Antimicrobial coating is offered as an add-on option in conjunction with our other services, such as siding or roof replacement. Call us for details on adding it to your project.
Protect Your Siding and Roof from the Pesky Microbes!
You can rely on Everest Siding and Windows to provide efficient, effective and reliable services. It is our commitment to provide the best services using the highest quality materials on the market, and our antimicrobial coating service is no exception. Call us now at (832) 334-2528 to inquire how we can extend the life and beauty of your exterior house envelope and keep the mold, mildew and algae away.

## Brick Waterproofing in Houston, TX
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/brick-waterproofing-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2026-07-28
Summary: Keep your brick structure safe from water damage and more with our effective brick waterproofing in Houston, TX.

Brick Waterproofing in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
Bricks give a timeless appearance to your property and ensure your safety and comfort. They are pretty durable and require little maintenance. However, there is an additional step you can take to extend its beauty and longevity: brick waterproofing. When you contact Everest Siding and Windows for your brick waterproofing needs, our experts in Houston, TX will always deliver exceptional results.
How Does It Work?
We use a proprietary water-based Silane-Siloxane water repellent and impregnating sealer for concrete and masonry surfaces.
It penetrates and chemically bonds deep within the substrate to form a hydrophobic barrier within the pores.
Resistant to freeze-thaw cycles, de-icing salts, mold, mildew, fungus and efflorescence
Once sealed, substrate become less susceptible to cracking, spalling, pitting, staining, mold, mildew, algae and efflorescence.
The product will not impair the natural breathing characteristics of treated substrates, nor will it produce a film or coating.
Water and other liquids will bead off sealed concrete, brick, stone, pavers and other masonry
Breathable, non-yellowing, won’t leave behind a surface film or coating
Approved by the department of transportation as a water repellent sealer in several states
Even after the bead goes away, the sealer will continue to work in the pores for up to 7-10 years
Can be used to seal concrete driveways, brick chimneys, paver patios, stone walls, pool decks, and more
Frequently Asked Questions
How does brick waterproofing work?
We apply a water-based silane-siloxane sealer that penetrates and chemically bonds within the pores of the masonry to form a hydrophobic barrier. Water beads off the surface while the substrate still breathes — no film or coating is left behind.
How long does the treatment last?
Even after the visible water-beading effect fades, the sealer keeps working within the pores for roughly 7 to 10 years, helping protect against cracking, spalling, staining, mold, and efflorescence.
What surfaces can be sealed?
It can be used on brick, concrete, stone, pavers, and other masonry — including chimneys, driveways, paver patios, stone walls, and pool decks. It’s offered as an add-on to our other services.
Trust Our Experts and Call Us Today!
When you hire us for your brick waterproofing service, we will treat your home like our own. Our dedicated crew will not only waterproof your bricks, but also investigate and find out if there are any warnings that might cause any issues in the future. We will ensure your bricks will stay strong and protect your home for the longest time. Dial (832) 334 2528 to get started now!

GAF Roofing in Houston, TX
Enjoy the perfect combination of beauty and advanced roof protection from eave to ridge!
Durability is what you look for most when choosing a roof material and GAF Timberline HDZ delivers every time. A Timberline HDZ roof is so much more than shingles; it’s layers of protection, working together to help keep your home safe from rain, ice, sun, and wind.
What are the benefits of GAF Timberline HDZ shingles?
High Definition Color – Patented High Definition® shadow bands create exceptional depth and dimension.
Engineered for the Best Installation – patented LayerLock™ Technology and the StrikeZone™ nailing area help roofers do their best work.
Advanced Algae Protection – Proprietary GAF Time-Release algae protection technology resists algae in a whole new way.
Industry-Leading Warranty – one of the strongest and longest-lasting products on the market and comes with a top-tier warranty for all new roofs.

Lets Talk!
Schedule Your Free Consultation!
GAF Architectural Asphalt Shingles
With GAF being the industry leader in roofing systems today, there is much to be said about their HDZ roofing shingles. As the number one selling shingle in America, they offer a wide array of features that have attracted homeowners, builders and contractors alike with their ability to both protect and improve a home’s outward appearance. We put our trust in excellence, which is why we choose GAF Timberline HDZ when it comes to shingles. You can rely on our roofing replacement services for your Houston, TX, property!
Timberline HDZ Shingles
Timberline HDZ Shingles are adhered in place with Dura Grip Self-Seal that assures that each shingle piece is tightly sealed and remains in place with no sudden blow-offs. All new roofing systems come with a GAF transferable lifetime limited warranty and a sound installation through the expertise of our certified installers.
Timberline goes above and beyond to bring you superior shingles, which makes them top-of-the-line for several reasons.
Wind Resistance
GAF Timberline HDZ shingles pass one of the industry’s toughest wind resistance tests: ASTM D3161, Class F, 110 mph (testing performed under controlled laboratory conditions). GAF Timberline® HDZ™’s wind rating is 130 mph.
Class A Fire Rating
GAF Timberline HDZ shingles come with a Class A fire rating from Underwriters Laboratories, the highest rating possible, making your home not only more beautiful, but safer as well.
StainGuard Plus™ Protection
The dark stains you see on a roof are often caused by tiny cyanobacteria called Gloeocapsa magma — a bacteria commonly known as blue-green algae. These bacteria travel on the wind and thrive in moist environments such as ours — so if one house in a neighborhood has it, others have probably been exposed as well. GAF Time-Release Algae-Fighting Technology helps prevent these stains to protect a home’s curb appeal.
Durable and Secure
Dura Grip™ Adhesive seals each shingle tightly and reduces the risk of shingle blow-off. It helps protect your roof from winds and wind-driven rain. GAF Timberline HDZ Shingles are warranted to withstand winds up to 130 mph.
Great Value
GAF Timberline HDZ is not only architecturally stylish, but also practically priced— and comes with a Lifetime Limited Transferable Warranty with Smart Choice®Protection (non-prorated material and installation labor coverage) for the first ten years.
High-Definition Color and Dimensional Look
GAF Timberline HDZ singles feature the patented High Definition® shadow bands which create exceptional depth and dimension.
High Performance
Designed with Advanced Protection® Technology, which minimizes the use of natural resources while providing superior protection for your home.
When you install a GAF Timberline HDZ roof with the Advanced Protection® Shingle, you’re getting the very best combination of weight and performance, wind and fire resistance, and flexibility that modern manufacturing technology can deliver.
Kind to the Environment
GAF Advanced Protection Shingles eliminate the unnecessary waste of natural resources because they use less asphalt and limestone than conventional shingles. They reduce transportation waste because they are weight-optimized to minimize fuel use. The shingles result in less landfill waste when they are eventually replaced and can be recycled to benefit the environment. That’s why GAF supports a recycling program that allows their contractors to recycle old shingles for reuse in roadways!
Your roof can represent up to 40% of your home’s curb appeal. Now, you can improve its resale value with Timberline HDZ Shingles from GAF, choosing from a variety of beautiful colors- patented High Definition® shadow bands create exceptional depth and dimension.

## Gutter Cleaning in Houston, TX
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/gutter-cleaning-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2026-07-28
Summary: We offer effective gutter cleaning in Houston, TX, to prevent your property from damage and keep the structure intact. Call us today!

Gutter Cleaning in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
Gutters are designed to direct rainwater away from your home, preserving your foundation, walls and landscape. Wet leaves, ticks, twigs, pebbles, dirt, and other elements can clog up your gutters, affecting their proper functionality. Our skilled crew has the skills and expertise you need for gutters cleaning in Houston, TX. We will get rid of the clog, restoring the optimal gutters’ functionality and protecting your home. Call Everest Siding and Windows now for a thorough cleaning of your gutters!
We Maintain Quality to Deliver Effective Services
When you call us for gutter cleaning, we will treat your gutters like our own. Our dedicated crew will not only clean, but also investigate and find out if there are any warnings that might prevent your gutters from working properly in the future. We will ensure your gutters will perform at full capacity.
Benefits of Our Gutter Cleaning Service in Houston, TX
Regular gutter cleaning is a crucial aspect of home maintenance that often goes overlooked but offers significant benefits. Gutters protect the doors, ceilings, and walls of your property from water damage. All of these can be in jeopardy if your gutters are not regularly cleaned, as leaves, dust, twigs, and debris collect there and prevent them from working properly. You can make sure that does not happen by opting for our gutter cleaning service!
Gutters play a vital role in channeling rainwater away from your home, preventing potential damage to the foundation, siding, and landscaping. Over time, leaves, twigs, and debris can accumulate in gutters, causing clogs and obstructing the smooth flow of water. This can lead to water pooling, which may result in soil erosion, structural damage and water infiltration. By investing in routine gutter cleaning, you not only ensure the proper functioning of your drainage system but also mitigate the risk of costly repairs and potential health hazards, such as mold growth. Our experts will clean your Houston property’s gutters thoroughly to ensure proper functionality and prevent future problems.
We will remove the leaves, sticks, and other debris that serve as nesting places for pests. If you neglect cleaning your gutters for a long time, rats, mice, birds, mosquitoes, and other pests can settle there. Once the pests start breeding, it paves the way for a new series of problems.
Additionally, well-maintained gutters contribute to the overall curb appeal of your home, enhancing its aesthetic value and longevity. Regular attention to gutter cleaning is a proactive measure that safeguards your property, preserving its structural integrity and minimizing the risk of water-related issues.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why is regular gutter cleaning important?
Clogged gutters can cause water to pool and lead to soil erosion, foundation and siding damage, and mold growth. They can also become nesting spots for pests. Keeping them clear protects your home’s structure.
What's included in your gutter cleaning service?
We remove leaves, twigs, and debris to restore proper water flow, and we inspect your gutters for any warning signs that could affect their performance down the road.
Is gutter cleaning a standalone service?
It’s offered as an add-on option in conjunction with our other services. Give us a call to add it to your project.

Hardie Plank Siding Contractor in Houston, TX
Enjoy the beauty of your home for years to come, with durable and sturdy siding!
Hardie Plank siding and trim is designed to withstand the weather, water, time, fire and pests. That’s why James Hardie’s hardworking products are engineered to stand up beautifully, whatever the elements.
What are the benefits of Hardie Plank siding?
Tested for Texas Climate – All styles are Engineered for Climate and come primed or with baked-on ColorPlus Technology.
Good Fire Protection – James Hardie’s Products are non-combustible and will not ignite when exposed to a direct flame, nor will it contribute fuel to a fire.
Long Warranty – All Hardie Plank products come with a 30-year limited warranty.
Unsusceptible to Pests – James Hardie fiber cement siding offers little appeal to critters and won’t be eaten by termites.
All backed by Everest Siding and Windows ’ own Lifetime Labor Warranty, price and satisfaction guaranteed, on every project.
Lets Talk!
Schedule Your Free Consultation!
Hardie Plank
Using the technical and manufacturing expertise it developed in Australia, James Hardie Inc. expanded its operations to become a world-leading, specialized, high-technology manufacturer of a wide range of fiber-cement building materials. The businesses employ over 2,500 people who generate revenue of more than $1.5 billion a year.
Hardie Plank lap siding is one of the most popular brands of siding in America, protecting and beautifying many homes from coast to coast. All styles are Engineered for Climate and come primed or with baked-on ColorPlus Technology.
HardiePlank Products
HardiePlank products are popular for many reasons, including the following:
Moisture and Rot Resistant
Natural wood siding has a tendency to expand, buckle, crack, and mold when repeatedly exposed to precipitation. Vinyl siding installations may put you at risk for water intrusion, especially around windows and trim joints. James Hardie products are specifically engineered to withstand damage from moisture and rot. They will hold their own in rain, sleet, or snow.
Durable over Time
One thing’s for sure: As the years go on, we all show signs of aging. However, since James Hardie products are created to stand up to the demands of the specific climate in Houston, they will look great for years, saving you time and money. With James Hardie’s added benefit of ColorPlus Technology—a baked-on color option that resists fading—your siding will look great without excessive maintenance.
Offer Good Fire Protection
In case of a fire, you want to know that the walls of your house will protect you while your family seeks safety. Fire feasts on wood, and it melts vinyl almost instantly. But James Hardie’s siding will not ignite when exposed to a direct flame, nor will it contribute fuel to a fire. This is because James Hardie’s products are non-combustible, and many insurance companies offer a discount.
Unsusceptible to Pests
Wood siding can be pecked by birds and devoured by insects. James Hardie fiber cement siding in Houston offers little appeal to critters and won’t be eaten by termites. You can focus on the animals in your life that actually make you happy, not on those that cause distress and damage.
Hardie Plank Siding Options
Traditional and timeless, Hardie Plank lap siding is one of the most popular brand of siding in North America, protecting and beautifying many homes from coast to coast.
Hardie Plank ColorPlus Technology
ColorPlus Technology is James Hardie’s proprietary finish applied inside a controlled factory setting to help eliminate debris and optimize adhesion to give you a lower maintenance solution. The finish is cured in between coats in a controlled environment for an even stronger bond that resists chipping, peeling and cracking. ColorPlus Technology resists fading and looks good for longer.
ColorPlus Technology finish comes with a 15-year limited warranty that covers paint and labor, protecting against peeling, cracking, and chipping.

LP Smartside Siding Contractor in Houston, TX
Enjoy the beauty of natural wood without the cost and the maintenance!

LP SmartSide
LP Building Products has been delivering innovative building products for over 50 years. LP is continuously working toward creating stronger, longer lasting and more innovative products while focusing on protecting the environment. Not only are they committed to developing products that are engineered to perform and built to stand the test of time, but they are also committed to protecting the environment by reducing emissions, waste and water use through their environmental initiatives.
LP uses an SFI-certified forest management and fiber sourcing system to help ensure that the wood that goes into their products comes from well-maintained forests.
LP SmartSide engineered wood trim and siding improves on all characteristics of natural wood, which has allowed this brand to become a top choice among remodelers and homeowners alike.
Engineered wood combines treated wood strands or fibers and adhesive resins to produce a composite material that is stronger than natural wood. The addition of special water-resistant waxes and zinc borate allows engineered wood to resist decay, even in rainy, humid environments.
See below why LP SmartSide is the superior choice when it comes to your siding replacement project:
Climate Tested to the Extremes
LP has long put the durability of SmartSide products to the test by subjecting them to the intense moisture and thriving termite colonies of Hilo, Hawaii, since 1996. It’s a harsh jungle environment with high humidity and 170 inches of rainfall annually – the ideal conditions for fungal decay. Even after many years of exposure, LP SmartSide products remain structurally sound.
More Impact Resistant
LP SmartSide siding products are more resistant than fiber cement products to impact damage from common projectiles such as golf balls, baseballs, and rocks.
Warm Appeal and Craftsmanship of Engineered Wood
With its deep cedar grain texture and defining shadow lines, LP SmartSide siding gives you the undeniable look of real wood, unlike fiber cement and vinyl siding. LP SmartSide is always a smart choice when accenting homes that are partially finished in stone, stucco, or brick. The beautiful contrast of these exterior claddings creates an architectural balance that’s visually appealing and welcoming.
Engineered to Offer the Workability of Wood
LP SmartSide comes in lengths up to 16’ for fewer seams and faster installation. They are more durable, so they resist breakage better. Moreover, they can be cut with standard woodworking tools.
Longer Warranty
LP SmartSide products come backed by an industry-leading 5/50-year limited warranty.
SmartGuard®- The Strength of Smart Engineering
All LP SmartSide products are designed for beauty and durability and feature an innovative, four component SmartGuard manufacturing process for strength and to resist fungal decay and termites.
Every LP SmartSide product is treated to the core with an advanced formula of binders, waxes and zinc borate before being bonded with a water-resistant, resin-saturated overlay. This process helps keep out moisture for long-term durability and strength against harsh weather.

## Malarkey Roofing in Houston, TX
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/malarkey-roofing-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2026-07-28
Summary: Everest Siding and Windows installs premium Malarkey roofing in Houston with green high performance shingles and professional service.

Malarkey Roofing in Houston, TX
Enjoy the perfect combination of beauty and advanced roof protection from eave to ridge!
If durability and sustainability are important to you when choosing roofing shingles, Malarkey architectural shingles are one of the best options. Malarkey shingles are some of the industry’s most sustainable, high performance roofing shingles on the market. Through their innovation and dedication to excellence, Malarkey shingles help keep your home safe from rain, ice, sun, and wind.
What are the benefits of Malarkey shingles?
3M Smog Reducing Granules – help clean the air of emission pollutants.
The Zone – Larger Nailing Area – greater accuracy, less blow-offs, less leaks, happier customers.
Rubberized Asphalt and Adhesives – industry leading all weather resilience; resists dry out and seals out extreme weather.
Industry-Leading Warranty – one of the strongest and longest-lasting shingle and algae warranties on the market.
All backed by Evere st Siding and Windows’ own Lifetime Labor Warranty, price and satisfaction guaranteed, on every project.
Lets Talk!
Schedule Your Free Consultation!
Malarkey Roofing
Malarkey is a family business that was started here in the US in 1956. Their guiding principle is simple: build the shingles they would want on their own homes, and make them better to last longer, and with the least environmental impact.
Malarkey shingles are engineered with extra adhesive bonds for added protection against wind, rain, and delamination, and a larger nailing area to improve installation speed, ease, and accuracy. Unlike standard shingles, which are brittle, easily crack, and quickly lose granules, Malarkey shingles are made of rubberized asphalt for industry-leading tear strength, granule adhesion, and wind and hail resistance.
They are also an industry leader in performance, innovation, and sustainability, being the first company to launch SBS polymer modified (rubberized) asphalt shingles, the first to engineer a larger nailing area and tapered shim, and the first to incorporate upcycled rubber, plastics, and smog-reducing granules.
3M Smog-Reducing Granules
Smog is a form of air pollution resulting from the interaction of UV sunlight with chemicals in the atmosphere like nitrogen oxides that get into the air primarily from the burning of fuel (ex. vehicle emissions). As a gas, smog is easily inhaled, making it extremely hazardous to humans and animals, and can lead to severe health risks including lung tissue damage, bronchial infections, and heart problems.
Malarkey’s 3M Smog-Reducing Granules (featured in TIME Magazine’s 50 Best Inventions of 2018), harness sunlight to photocatalytically convert smog (nitrogen oxides like NO2) into water-soluble ions (NO3), a plant usable form of nitrogen that washes away with rainwater as a mild fertilizer, actively reducing air pollution. One roof has the same smog-fighting potential as 2 or more trees (assuming standard roof of 30 squares).
Malarkey Laminated Architectural Shingles
The Highlander AR, Vista AR, and Legacy Scotchgard shingle lines are designed to give a dimensional appearance to the roof. These products offer a range of options providing impact resistance and protection from algae staining.
All shingle lines have specific features, but they also have some common ones:
Fire Resistance
Class A fire rating (highest rating possible).
Formulated Adhesive Bonds and Rain Seals
Malarkey shingles contain up to 50% more adhesive bonds than standard shingles, as well as twice the rain seals. This leads to longer, stronger protection against high winds and wind-driven rain.
The Zone: Larger Nailing Area
Malarkey shingles offer a nailing area of 1 ¾” compared to the industry standard of 1/2”. This creates a bigger target, making it easier to hit which improves the speed and accuracy of the installation. This helps ensure every nail hits both shingle layers, properly securing the shingles to the roof and protecting against shingle uplift and blow-off.
Warranty
All shingle lines include a limited lifetime shingle warranty, as well as an enhanced wind warranty of up to 130 mph (209 kph).
Your roof can represent up to 40% of your home’s curb appeal. Highlander AR, Vista AR, or Legacy Scotchgard shingles from Malarkey come in a variety of appealing colors that will enhance the beauty of your new roofing system and the curb appeal of your home.
Highlander AR Shingle Line
Highlander is the industry’s first and only entry-level shingle to be constructed of NEX polymer modified (rubberized) asphalt. These shingles deliver all weather resilience and include granules that reduce algae streaks and help clean the air of emission pollutants.
Impact Resistance
Class 3 hail impact rating (second highest rating possible).
Limited lifetime shingle warranty and 10-year algae warranty.
Sustainability
Each roof diverts the equivalent of ~4 rubber tires and ~2,900 plastic bags from landfill (assuming standard roof of 30 squares).
Vista AR Shingle Line
Vista AR shingles are made with NEX Rubberized Asphalt, are resistant to algae, and deliver all weather resilience and include granules that help clean the air of emission pollutants. They also meet the Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety’s (IBHS) stringent FORTIFIED roof requirements.
Class 4 hail impact rating (highest rating possible).
Limited lifetime shingle warranty and 15-year algae warranty.
Each roof diverts the equivalent of ~5 rubber tires and ~3,200 plastic bags from landfill (assuming standard roof of 30 squares).
Legacy Scotchgard Shingle Line
Legacy Scotchgard shingles are the best in their class. They are made with NEX Rubberized Asphalt, deliver all weather resilience, and include granules that reduce algae streaks and help clean the air of emission pollutants. They also meet the Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety’s (IBHS) stringent FORTIFIED roof requirements.
Limited lifetime shingle warranty and algae warranty.
Each roof diverts the equivalent of ~6 rubber tires and ~4,000 plastic bags from landfill (assuming standard roof of 30 squares).

Pressure Washing in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
Give your home a makeover! Clean and neat home grounds catch everyone’s attention and make your home stand out.

Introducing Pressure Washing
Your home outside envelope (walls and roof) is not the only one that needs clenaing and maintenance. Your driveway, pathways, patio, and/or deck can also benefit from regular cleaning. We use pressurized water to clean dirt, algae, bird droppings, or any other contaminants from the outdoor surfaces of your property, leaving them clean and refreshed.
Our team changes the method depending on the machine used as well as the surface being cleaned. We will thoroughly inspect your property to proceed with the right technique. You can rely on us to use advanced methods when cleaning your property.
Perks of Pressure Washing

Maintains Property Value: You can maintain the value of your property with our pressure washing service. When a building becomes dirty over time, it looks dull and unkept, decreassing in value. Our pressure washing services will restore your home and its grounds to its original glory.
Saves Time: Pressure washing takes time and effort and many times requires specific equipment. Let us do the heavy work for you!
Prevents Repairs: In time, dirt and grime can damage the integrity of your property if not removed. We will dispose of the contaminants and prevent your property from deteriorating. By doing so, we decrease the likelihood of repairs you might need in the future.
Lowers Risk of Pest Infestation: Pests, such as bugs, can make a home on the exterior of your building, affecting the appearance. Our pressure washing services can lower the risk of a potential pest infestation.

Why is regular pressure washing worth it?
It helps maintain your property value, prevents dirt and grime from damaging surfaces over time, saves you the time and effort of doing it yourself, and lowers the risk of pest infestation. It’s offered as an add-on service.

Roof Cleaning in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
The outdoor surfaces around your property are constantly exposed to nature elements, leaving them looking dirty and dull. Your roof is no exception. Our pressure and soft washing services will remove dirt, algae and other contaminants from your roof making it shine again and prolonging its life span.
Importance of Our Roof Cleaning Service
Having a roof is important, but maintaining it is of even more significance! Everest Siding and Windows is here to clean your roof of all the dirt, debris, algae, mold, and other contaminants that affect its lifespan.
We will use the proper techniques to thoroughly clean your roof, depending on the type of roofing system you have. We work alongside a highly talented crew to keep your roof looking its best.

Roof/Attic Insulation Benefits

Improves energy efficiency: Blown-in insulation can improve your home’s energy efficiency, reducing energy bills.

Prevents air leaks: Blown-in insulation’s small particles fit into nooks and crannies, creating a tight seal that prevents hot and cold air from entering your home.
Stabilizes temperatures and prolongs the HVAC system life span: Blown-in insulation keeps temperatures more stable, so your HVAC system doesn’t have to work as hard, which can save money and extend the life of your system.

## Roof Radiant Barrier Installation in Houston, TX
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/roof-radiant-barrier-installation-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2026-07-28
Summary: You no longer have to experience heat gain inside your home, thanks to our radiant barrier installation in Houston, TX.

Roof Radiant Barrier Installation in Houston, TX
Schedule A Free Consultation
(This service is offered as an add-on option, in conjunction with our other comprehensive services. For more details, feel free to call us.)
If you are looking for an efficient and cost-effective way to keep your Houston, TX home cool during the summer, a possible solution may be a professional radiant barrier installation.
What is a Radiant Barrier?
A radiant barrier is a highly reflective material that repels the heat penetrating the attic instead of absorbing it. It acts as an additional layer for keeping heat from entering your home.
However, a radiant barrier is not the same as attic insulation. Therefore, it does not reduce heat conduction like thermal insulation materials. Instead, it acts as a supplement to the insulation you may already have in your attic. So, the question is whether it is worth it to install a radiant barrier and if it reduces your heating costs during the hot months.
How Roof Radiant Barrier Works
The average temperature in Texas during the summer is between 86 and 98 degrees Fahrenheit. When combined with low rainfall and humidity, 90-degree temperatures can feel unbearable. As part of a whole-attic system, radiant barriers can improve the comfort of your home.
During the summer, the sun’s UV rays and the heat they produce can penetrate your home’s roof. The heat travels from a warm area to a cool area (i.e., your home) via radiation, convection, and conduction.
Conduction – heat transfers through the house materials such as the roofing, wood frame, drywall, etc.
Convection – Gas or liquid loses its density and rises. Any heat below the house may rise into a room.
Radiation – Heat travels horizontally from a surface (i.e., your walls) and increases the temperature of any material that absorbs its energy.
The heat invades your home from the attic, walls, and even the flooring. When you install a radiant barrier, it keeps the heat from accumulating. In essence, it prevents heat buildup. When combined with insulation, a radiant barrier effectively reduces the amount of heat that enters your home.
What Are the Roof Radiant Barrier Benefits?
You Save Money on Cooling Costs
There’s no question that radiant barriers cut down on cooling costs during the hottest months. The Department of Energy has suggested that in sunny regions, installing radiant barriers reduces cooling costs by 5% to 10%. In the hottest areas such as Houston, TX, those energy savings can be even greater. However, when combined with insulation, barriers can cut your cooling bill in half. Naturally, the results will vary depending on the size of your home and if it is well-insulated. However, every little bit helps. A radiant barrier may put $200 to $300 back in your pocket annually.
It Lasts a Long Time
Importantly, it is mentioned that radiant barriers have a lifespan of 80 to 100 years, providing lasting energy savings and cost-effectiveness beyond the initial payback period. This makes them a smart choice for homeowners looking to enhance energy efficiency and lower utility expenses over the long run.
Radiant Barriers Are Non-Toxic
Whether you are healthy or suffer from health issues, you do not have to worry about radiant barriers contaminating your home. Barriers do not emit harmful particles that can harm your body. Unlike insulation, radiant barriers do not irritate your lungs, eyes, or skin. They are made of non-toxic materials that are safe to use in the home.
Barriers Have a High R-Value
R-Value measures how much thermal energy passes through a surface. The higher the R-value, the greater the insulative properties of the material. The materials in a radiant barrier can reflect up to 97 percent of radiant heating, giving it a higher R-value than most attic or wall insulation types. When combined with insulation, a radiant barrier creates a nearly impenetrable envelope around the house.
Humidity Does Not Affect Radiant Barriers
Humidity is not an issue in most areas in Texas. However, southern and eastern Texas has higher humidity levels than northern and western Texas. Thankfully, no matter where you live in Texas, radiant barriers are unaffected by humidity because they reflect heat and do not absorb it.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a radiant barrier, and how is it different from insulation?
A radiant barrier is a highly reflective material that repels attic heat instead of absorbing it. It doesn’t replace insulation — it supplements it, reflecting radiant heat while your insulation handles heat conduction.
How much can a radiant barrier save me?
The Department of Energy notes radiant barriers can cut cooling costs by about 5% to 10% in sunny regions, and even more in hot areas like Houston. That can put roughly $200 to $300 back in your pocket each year, and paired with insulation the savings grow further.
How long does a radiant barrier last, and is it safe?
Radiant barriers have a lifespan of about 80 to 100 years. They’re made of non-toxic materials that won’t irritate skin, eyes, or lungs, are unaffected by humidity, and reflect up to 97% of radiant heat for a high effective R-value.
Call us for the best Roof Radiant Barrier Installation Service!
Ready to save on your energy bills? Everest Siding and Windows offers reliable roof radiant barrier installation services. By trusting us, you can rest assured that your home will give you the comfort level you desire and the energy savings you need. You can get in touch with us at (832) 334 2528 .

Highly Energy-Efficient
Windows made from vinyl are strong and provide very good energy savings having moderate to high R-values meaning that they are resistant to heat flow. The higher the R-value, the greater the resistance and the higher their energy efficiency, which in the long run will save you in heating and cooling costs.
Easy to Clean
Most vinyl windows have tilt-in glass to make it easy to clean the outside of the window. They’re also resistant to the elements, so they don’t age as fast as other windows.
Inexpensive
Vinyl is the least expensive of all window materials, but this doesn’t mean vinyl windows are low quality. Vinyl is durable, and it won’t rust or corrode.
Wide Variety and Versatile
Vinyl windows have many colors, sizes, and style options, from awning to picture, making them a great choice for custom made windows. Installation is relatively easy and quick; vinyl windows are easy to manufacture and manipulate for a wide range of products, including windows of all shapes and sizes.
Note: Because vinyl windows can’t be painted, choose a color you will be happy with forever. If you decide on another color down the line, the windows will have to be replaced.
Types of Windows
Windows come in a variety of styles and the price often depends on the shape of the window. Shaped windows (most often triangular or arched shaped) usually cost approximately $100-$300 more than the standard windows. Tempered glass and grids also impact the price of your windows replacement project.
To learn more about what styles of windows are available, check out the Window Styles document.
Impact Resistance Hurricane Windows and Patio Doors
Everest Siding and Windows also installs storm and hurricane windows for those homeowners that are located in coastal areas.
Hurricane windows are made with impact-resistance glass which is designed to help maintain your home’s structural integrity and add innovative protection for your home and family. When strong, hurricane winds enter a home through broken windows and doors, the increased pressure can lift off the roof and push out the structure. Adding plywood over your windows and doors will not solve the problem and will not ensure the safety of your family in case of a bad storm. Powerful winds can reach under those boards, rip them off, and then break through the windows anyway. Once a window is smashed, your entire house is at risk.
Meet Stringent Building Codes
Exceptionally strong polymer interlayer is sandwiched between two sheets of glass to reinforce your windows during a hurricane.
The interlayer holds the glass together if it’s shattered – helping prevent damage and injury that can be caused by wind, water and debris entering your home.
Can withstand an impact equivalent to that of a 2-by-4 traveling at 50 feet per second.
Added Safety and Security
Hurricane windows’ impact-resistant glass helps prevent forced entry – the interlayer cannot be easily penetrated, even if the glass is shattered.
No storm shutters are needed.
Hurricane windows and doors may add equity to your home and could reduce insurance premiums.
If you choose Everest Siding and Windows for your windows replacement project, you can rest easy knowing you will enjoy the lasting beauty, durability, and weatherability the products we recommend and install have to offer.
Why Choose Everest
Unique Business Model
No high-pressure salesman and no gimmicks. From no down payment to no interest finance options, we will work with you to find the best option for you, your budget, and your home.
The Highest Quality Products
We only use the best products on the market. With many small details that often go unnoticed by other contractors, we’ll take your remodeling project to the next level.
Quality Control
We have a dedicated project manager who is hands-on throughout the project.
Non-Stop Communication
One key to the success of your project is good communication and the ability to listen. From the beginning of a project to its end, our company places a high priority on listening – to you, your needs, and your wishes.
We Keep Our Promises
Trust is the cornerstone of our long-term success. We have served thousands of happy clients and look forward to serving you!
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a minimum for window replacement projects?
Yes, we have a minimum of 3 windows per replacement project. Please note we handle window replacement and installation, not individual window repairs.
What types of windows do you install?
We install energy-efficient vinyl windows in styles including single-hung, double-hung, casement, and sliding, plus impact-resistant hurricane windows and patio doors for added storm protection.
Why choose vinyl windows?
Vinyl is cost-effective, highly energy-efficient, weather- and UV-resistant, and virtually maintenance-free — it never needs painting or staining. The vinyl windows we recommend are manufactured specifically for the Texas climate.

## We Are Everest Siding And Windows
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/about/
Updated: 2026-01-09
Summary: At Everest Siding and Windows we are all about genuine care, quality craftsmanship, and transparent pricing for your dream sanctuary.

We Are Everest Siding And Windows
Schedule A Free Consultation
Everest Siding And Windows Story
Everest Siding and Windows was founded on a commitment to provide quality, eco-friendly, home improvement products at affordable prices. We are a multi-generation family owned and operated, a reason for which we are 100% involved and committed to doing everything it takes to ensure you, our customers, are happy.
Our Mission
To provide eco-friendly home improvement solutions that satisfy the needs and exceed the expectations of our customers.
Our Vision
Improving the quality of life in our communities.
Our Values
We commit to these values to guide our decisions and actions:
Customer Service Excellence
We are dedicated to satisfying customer needs and honoring all commitments that we have made to them. We are committed to providing personal attention to each one of our customers at all times.
Accountability
We accept our individual and team responsibilities and we meet our commitments. We take responsibility for our performance in all of our decisions and actions. We make and support business decisions through experience and good judgment with the ultimate goal of providing a positive experience for our customers.
Integrity
We act with honesty and integrity at all times, without compromise.
Passion for Results
We show pride, enthusiasm, and dedication in everything that we do. We are committed to providing outstanding services, delivered as promised, on time and on budget.
Respect
We treat our associates, customers, partners, and suppliers with mutual respect, recognize the importance of diversity, and respect all individuals and value their contribution.
History
Everest was formed with the single belief that homeowners deserve the highest quality products installed by the highest trained installers, that is why we do not subcontract our projects out to untrained, unskilled, self-taught, or even semi-skilled workers.
After working at some of Houston’s largest siding and window companies, Richard- who oversees not only your initial consultation, but also the whole process from concept to completion- realized that the lack of skills in the workforce in general was a gaping hole in the marketplace for homeowners.
Richard was initially surprised at the way certification is handed out in the siding and window industry. Most homeowners aren’t aware that very, very rarely are the actual installers who are performing the work on homeowners’ homes actually certified or even professionally trained. In most cases, the company has completed an online exam and once that is passed, the company is certified. The crews on the ground are not put through official training and are not themselves trained to install to manufacture’s specifications.
This allows for installation issues and sub-standard practices to be commonplace, despite the company carrying official certification. At Everest not only is everyone who works in production a certified installer, but each crew member from the crew leader down to the other crew members, are all trained by the manufacturer in a hands-on environment, to install not only to manufacturer specifications, but also constantly updated with ongoing training and best practices.
Should you decide to hire Everest for your project, not only will you receive daily inspections by your project manager, but a detailed proposed agenda of how and when the project will proceed. We also handle all HOA approval if needed and pull permits where applicable to ensure a smooth and seamless installation. We do not require down payments as we do not need customers to fund the projects and payment will only be requested on satisfactory completion of the project.
We believe we have a unique approach to making sure your relationship with Everest isn’t just hiring a contractor, but rather an experience to be enjoyed.
Our work Philosophy
Our philosophy is in most part a of the direct result of Richard’s years in the British military:
Set The Agenda
Give all info that is relevant to all parties involved.
Attention To Detail
From ordering all necessary materials to inspection of materials on delivery, correct installation being performed (daily inspections), daily clean-up of job site, etc.
Constant Communication
Both with homeowners and crew members to ensure all parties are on the same page at all times.
Accountability From Top To Bottom
All employees and installers performance are reviewed on a monthly basis and you, the homeowner, are asked to evaluate everyone you have contact with by way of a Customer Satisfaction Survey that is completed at the end of your project.
Specialists In Each Area Of Activity
We do not want or allow roofers to install windows, siding installers to do roofing, window installers to install siding etc. Only if they are trained and certified and have expertise in two areas, they will do both.

## FAQs
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/faqs/
Updated: 2025-10-02
Summary: Get quick answers to common questions about Everest Siding and Windows. Your home transformation FAQs, answered.

FAQs
Need Some Quick Answers?
Schedule A Free Consultation
Siding FAQs
Is the LP SmartSide architectural series cedar shake siding primed?
Yes. It is primed on the face and edges.
Can I use a traditional transparent or semi-transparent stain on LP SmartSide products?
No. These stains are typically low in solids and provide less protection from UV and other weathering effects. There are new acrylic latex paints commercially available that can replicate the appearance of a semitransparent stain. Refer to the installation instructions for proper finishing.
Can I install LP SmartSide trim over lap siding, rather than butting to it?
Yes. Special precautions should be taken to provide proper spacing between the lap siding and the trim, as well as fastening of the trim.
Can LP SmartSide panel siding be installed horizontally or diagonally?
No. LP SmartSide panel siding is designed specifically to be installed parallel to the framing. Refer to the LP SmartSide® Precision series panel siding installation instructions.
What kind of nails do I need?
Corrosion resistant fasteners must be used to avoid rust staining and erosion of the fasteners. Please refer to the proper installation instructions and code report for the minimum size and type, as well as the fastening schedule.
If the installation is not consistent with the application instructions, will it void my warranty?
The LP SmartSide limited warranty will remain in effect with the exception that any issue caused by an installation that varies from the LP SmartSide installation instructions will not be the responsibility of LP. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.on the face and edges.
Can I install LP SmartSide lap vertically and cover the joint with battens?
No. LP SmartSide siding is designed for horizontal installation only. Un‐grooved LP SmartSide Precision series panel siding is available for board and batten applications. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
What is the fire rating?
LP SmartSide is a class C (III) rated product when tested according to ASTM E84. All LP® SmartSide® siding can be used in a 1‐hour fire rated assembly when it is installed over 5/8 type‐X gypsum, which is consistent with other siding types such as fiber cement siding.
How do I install LP SmartSide siding over SIP or ICF assemblies?
Follow the LP SmartSide installation instructions. The SIP manufacturer will need to specify the type of corrosion resistant fastener and the fastener spacing to meet the minimum required wind‐load values. The fastener spacing must not exceed the maximum fastener spacing stated in the LP SmartSide installation instructions. If you have further questions, contact the LP Technical staff at (800) 450‐6106. Consult your local code authority to ensure compliance with the local building code.
Is it beneficial to prime the back side of the LP SmartSide siding or trim?
No. Back priming has proven to be useful to control tannin staining with some types of solid wood siding, trim, and some composite sidings. LP SmartSide products are designed to perform without back priming.
Should we caulk at the overlap of the lap siding?
No. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Can we rip lap to create a smaller size?
It may be necessary to rip the lap siding at times where the wall terminates at the soffit or around penetrations. Use special care to prime and paint any exposed wood that may result. Ripping the lap siding to make narrower lap siding is not recommended.
Can LP SmartSide trim and fascia be miter cut?
Do not miter cut the edges or ends of the trim at corners. Miter cuts or “picture framing” around door and window openings are acceptable. Butt joints are preferred but scarfed joints are permitted with LP SmartSide trim and fascia. All joints must be spaced 3/16 inch to accommodate expansion during equilibration. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Can I overlap my LP SmartSide siding more than the recommended 1”?
Yes, but the siding should not project beyond the thickness of the trim. The specified overlap and edge‐spacing of the nails in the installation instructions are minimum requirements. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Are there any special considerations when applying any panel siding to the interior of my home and is this application allowed and will my warranty be good?
Using LP SmartSide in an interior application is acceptable. Please review the material safety data sheet (MSDS) before using the product indoors
When panels are installed, is it ok to allow the panel to rest on the flashing?
No. A drainage space is required between the panel drip edge and the flashing. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Now that your fiber products have Zinc Borate, can they be used west of the Cascades?
LP SmartSide Architectural and Precision Series Siding can be used west of the Cascades. Certain LP SmartSide Foundations Series siding cannot. See the Smart Side warranty for complete details.
Are LP SmartSide products “green”?
The green attributes built into LP products today are recognized in green building certification programs around the country, most often in the “Materials & Resource Efficiency” section. LP uses 100% SFI‐certified wood – a renewable resource from small diameter, rapidly regenerating trees. LP SmartSide products are treated with environmentally friendly borates to resist rot, termites, and mold. LP SmartSide is durable and comes with a 50‐year limited warranty.
Can LP SmartSide siding be used in a one‐hour fire‐rated wall assembly?
Yes. It must be installed over 5/8‐inch type‐x gypsum the same as fiber cement siding.
Are LP SmartSide products compliant with the building code?
Yes. LP SmartSide Precision series Lap and Panel siding is covered by the ESR‐1301 code report. LP SmartSide Foundation series lap and panel siding, and architectural shake and panel meet the requirements of ANSI 135.6 and therefore satisfy the requirements of the 2006 International Building Code. Code report NER‐626 also represents the Foundation and some of the Architectural series siding products.
Can LP SmartSide siding be fastened directly to the studs?
Certain LP SmartSide products can be attached to framed walls without sheathing such as Precision series siding. Refer to the LP SmartSide installation instructions for the specific type of LP SmartSide siding you are using. Note that a code‐approved breathable water‐resistive barrier is required between the siding and the studs.
Why are the LP SmartSide code reports important?
The code reports are published by the International Code Council and demonstrate the safe use of the siding. The code reports are useful to engineers, architects, and code officials to ensure the siding is used within its design limits.
Is a house‐wrap required behind the LP SmartSide siding?
A code‐approved, breathable, water‐resistive barrier is required behind all LP SmartSide siding as per the International Building Code. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Can I install LP SmartSide siding differently than what is specified in the LP SmartSide installation instructions?
LP strongly recommends LP SmartSide siding be installed according to the installation instructions. If the siding is installed in a manner inconsistent with the instructions, the siding will continue to be warranted under the LP SmartSide limited warranty although any issue caused by the inconsistent installation will not be the responsibility of LP. Refer to the installation instructions for proper installation.
Why is it important to space LP SmartSide siding at all joints?
LP SmartSide siding will expand naturally as its moisture level balances with the surrounding environment. Spacing the joints provides the necessary room for the siding to expand. This is also an important reason to properly apply a non‐hardening caul
[...]

Signs You Need Siding Replacement Services
Homeowners often overlook siding issues until they become more noticeable. Here are some common signs that indicate you need siding replacement:
Minor cracks or holes in your siding
The siding is pulling away from the house
Fading or discoloration of the siding
Peeling or bubbling paint indicates water damage
You may notice an increase in your energy bills due to inadequate insulation

Kingwood, called the “Livable Forest,” is a peaceful suburban area northeast of Houston. Homes here face high humidity, frequent storms, and seasonal flooding from the San Jacinto River, so strong, durable siding is necessary.
Siding here needs to resist mold, high winds, and sun damage while matching the neighborhood’s upscale, nature-inspired homes.
Local rules require siding to meet strict building codes, including IBC standards for hail and debris. We specialize in these types of siding, helping local homes maintain their aesthetics.
Complete Siding Services in Kingwood, TX
We offer complete siding services in Kingwood & nearby areas. Using high-quality materials like LP SmartSide and HardiePlank, we handle:

We offer siding installation in Kingwood, TX, that follows strict IBC codes for wind resistance up to 100 mph. It also includes housewrap, flashing, and trim for a tight, energy-efficient seal.
You can choose lap siding, vertical panels, or shakes in natural tones that match local oak-lined neighborhoods, increasing insulation and energy efficiency.
Siding Replacement
We offer siding replacement in Kingwood, TX, to update old or damaged exteriors affected by hail, floods, or sun exposure. The process includes removing old siding, clearing debris, and repairing any rot or mold underneath.
We install modern styles like board-and-batten or cedar-textured panels with Shermax coatings that come with a 50-year fade warranty. These upgrades comply with local HOA rules and reduce cooling costs during hot Texas summers.

How long does siding last?

How do I know if my home’s siding needs replacement?
If your siding is becoming loose or faded because of heat or moisture damage, and if there are signs of dry rot, blister, or bubbles on the siding, then it is time to call for replacement services.

Product

## 5 Benefits of Using Antimicrobial Coating
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/5-benefits-of-using-antimicrobial-coating/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: Discover the top five benefits of using antimicrobial coating in home remodeling. Learn how it improves hygiene, durability, and indoor air quality for modern homes.

5 Benefits of Using Antimicrobial Coating
Jan 30, 2026
Homeowners today expect more than good looks from their living spaces. They want healthier, safer, and longer-lasting homes. As a result, antimicrobial coating has become a popular addition in modern home remodeling projects.
This advanced surface treatment helps prevent the growth of bacteria, mold, and other harmful microbes, making it ideal for residential environments. Whether you are remodeling a kitchen, bathroom, or entire home, antimicrobial coating delivers both functional and long-term value.
Below are five key benefits that make it a smart choice for home renovation projects.
1. Improves Indoor Hygiene and Health
Antimicrobial coating actively inhibits the growth of bacteria, mold, and mildew on treated surfaces. In home remodeling, this benefit is especially valuable in high-touch and moisture-prone areas such as kitchens, bathrooms, door handles, cabinets, and countertops.
By reducing microbial growth, the coating helps minimize the spread of germs and allergens inside the home. This creates a healthier living environment, particularly for children, elderly residents, and individuals with allergies or respiratory issues.
Homeowners can enjoy peace of mind knowing their remodeled space supports better everyday hygiene.
2. Extends the Life of Remodeled Surfaces
Microorganisms do more than affect health; they can also degrade surfaces over time. Mold, mildew, and bacteria can cause stains, odors, and material breakdown. Antimicrobial coating protects surfaces by helping prevent this damage at the source.
In home remodeling projects, applying antimicrobial coatings to walls, tiles, wood, paint, and fixtures helps maintain their appearance and overall condition. As a result, surfaces last longer, reducing the need for frequent cosmetic repairs and increasing the overall return on investment.
3. Reduces Cleaning and Maintenance Effort
One major advantage of antimicrobial coating is that it simplifies cleaning routines. Because microbes struggle to grow on treated surfaces, dirt and odors do not build up as quickly.
For homeowners, this means less scrubbing, fewer harsh cleaning chemicals, and reduced maintenance costs. In remodeled kitchens and bathrooms, antimicrobial coatings keep surfaces fresher for longer, saving time while maintaining a clean and polished look.
This benefit is particularly appealing for busy households and rental properties.
4. Helps Control Mold and Mildew in Moisture-Prone Areas
Bathrooms, kitchens, basements, and laundry rooms often experience high humidity and moisture exposure. These conditions create the perfect environment for mold and mildew growth. Antimicrobial coating adds an extra layer of protection in these vulnerable areas.
When used in home remodeling, antimicrobial coatings help contain moisture-related microbial growth, preventing unpleasant odors and unsightly stains. This protection helps reduce odor-causing microbial buildup, helping remodeled spaces stay comfortable and visually appealing over time.
5. Adds Value to Modern Home Remodeling Projects
Homebuyers and homeowners increasingly prioritize health-focused and low-maintenance features. Antimicrobial coating aligns perfectly with this trend. Including it in a remodeling project positions the home as modern, innovative, and wellness-oriented.
For remodeling contractors, antimicrobial coatings offer a strong selling point that differentiates their services. For homeowners, this feature can increase property value and market appeal, especially in competitive real estate markets. Many modern siding and window materials now include built-in antimicrobial additives.
Summing It Up
Antimicrobial coating delivers far more than surface-level protection in home remodeling projects. It improves indoor hygiene, extends material lifespan, reduces maintenance, helps control moisture-related microbial growth, and adds long-term value to the home.
As homeowners continue to seek healthier and more durable living spaces, antimicrobial coatings stand out as a smart and practical remodeling solution.
To integrate this antimicrobial technique into your next home renovation, reach out to the contractors at Everest Siding and Windows . Call us at (832) 334-2528 and let’s start remodeling with advanced techniques.

## 5 Essential Tips for Keeping Your Patio Looking Great
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/5-essential-tips-for-keeping-your-patio-looking-great/
Updated: 2024-12-24
Summary: Learn 5 essential tips to maintain your patio's beauty and functionality year-round in this must-read guide!

5 Essential Tips for Keeping Your Patio Looking Great
Aug 30, 2024
An outdoor patio is like an extension of your own house. It can provide a nice place to dine, have coffee, catch up on your favorite book or just relax.
However, patios may wear off over time; exhibiting signs of repair and damages. Let’s discuss a few quick and easy care and maintenance tips to keep your patio looking great!
Why Patio Maintenance Is Important?
When you curate a space, you want it to look welcoming and cozy all the time. Same goes with patios, too.
An otherwise neglected patio can provide a breeding ground for weeds, moss, algae, and lichen. As these build up, they can make the surface look worn out and dirty.
This not only affects the appearance but also makes the patio slabs very slippery – which can pose multiple safety risks, especially in wet weather.
Patios are outdoor spaces. Which is why dust accumulation is a given. It might start looking grimy and dull without regular cleaning.
All these are some of the many reasons why patio maintenance is a must for homeowners. Let’s learn how you can do that!
How To Effectively Maintain Your Patio
Without further ado, let’s jump in to the essentials of maintaining your patio!
Regular Cleaning
As much as it is important to clean the inside of your house, it is equally important to clean your outside patio.
You should sweep your patio at least once or twice a week to get rid of the everyday dirt, mildew, and stains.
Conduct Preventive Maintenance
In order to make sure your patio lasts long, inspecting it for any initial damages can prevent you from extensive and costly repairs.
Take a quick rundown on the furniture, flooring, and their elements for any cracks or scratches.
Deep Clean Your Patio Once a Month
You can opt to clean your patio at least once a month to maintain its beauty and longevity.
In order to successfully deep clean your patio, use the right cleaners and clothes to remove stains or dirt.
Make sure to avoid pressure washing. It can splinter wood, chip pavers, and even concrete. If you still decide in favor of pressure washing, use the lowest setting and hold the spray wand away.
Seal Your Patio
Depending on the material of your patio structure, apply sealants to protect it.
Sealing a wood, concrete or flagstone patio will make cleaning and maintenance easier.
The frequency of sealing patios depends on the amount of foot traffic it receives. Make sure to identify any source of damage on your own or call professional help.
Get Rid of Weeds
If you haven’t brushed your patio while on holiday, you will be surprised at how quickly a weed can grow on patios.
You don’t want unusual green sprouts to take away the freshness of your patio. So, put your gloves right on, gather the right tools, and pull out as much of the roots as possible.
You might want to use weed killer to get rid of the roots so that it does not re-grow.
Final Words
Patio cleaning and maintenance is an integral part of home maintenance. You can schedule regular cleaning, deep cleaning, weed cutting and sealing your patio to always keep it fresh and clean.
At Everest Siding and Windows , we provide specialized expertise and distinctive outdoor living services. So, what are you waiting for? Call us at (832) 334-2528 to book our services.

## 5 Signs Your Siding Needs Replacement
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/5-signs-your-siding-needs-replacement/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: Signs like cracks or gaps, high energy costs, wood rot, interior damage, and the need for frequent repairs indicate the need for siding replacement.

5 Signs Your Siding Needs Replacement
Mar 15, 2025
Siding is one of the first things people notice on your home’s exterior. Apart from its aesthetic value, it is also the first line of defense against moisture, weather, and other external factors. Over time, siding can wear out, affecting its ability to protect your home.
In this blog, we will highlight 5 telltale signs that indicate the need for a complete siding replacement to restore its function!
Telltale Signs Your Siding Needs Replacement
If you find these signs of wear on your siding, it is time you should think about replacing it:
Cracks or Gaps
Cracks are more than just aesthetic issues. They serve as an entryway for moisture and water to seep into your interior, causing damage in the form of rot, mold, and mildew. It compromises your home’s integrity and even the health of your family. Gaps in the siding can also let in pests such as rats and termites.While small cracks can often be repaired, if there’s widespread damage or rotting a full replacement is usually needed to avoid more problems. You can schedule a siding inspection to gauge the severity of the problem.
Increased Energy Bills
Siding is responsible for your home’s insulation. Old or damaged siding may not protect your home well from heat in summer or cold in winter, leading to higher heating and cooling bills. To lower energy costs, you can choose energy-efficient options that prevent heat loss.A siding contractor can help you determine the exact problem and provide useful insights on energy-efficient and long-lasting materials that will save you money in the long run.
Wood Rot
Wood is susceptible to moisture damage. If you have wood siding installed, it is important to regularly inspect it for signs of rot.Look for discolored spots on the wood. The texture may also change, appearing spongy, stringy, or cracked. You might notice the wood breaking into cube-shaped pieces or crumbling into a sawdust-like substance.
Frequent Repairs
If your siding needs frequent repairs or repainting, it could be a sign of a complete replacement. Constant repairs can be costly and time-consuming.Hence, switching to a more durable and energy-efficient material, like vinyl or fiber cement, can reduce the need for frequent repairs and save you money in the long run.
Interior Water Damage
If you notice signs like water stains, loose wallpaper, or peeling paint, it might be time to consider a siding replacement. Siding protects your home from water damage, and if it is not doing its job, it’s about time you replace it.You can ask professionals to inspect the root cause of water damage and provide solutions accordingly.
Final Words
Siding is important for both your home’s look and protection. If you notice signs like water stains, peeling paint, cracks, wood rot, or frequent repairs, it might be time to replace it. Replacing old siding helps maintain your home’s safety, energy efficiency, and curb appeal while preventing costly repairs in the future.
Everest Siding and Windows specializes in siding replacement and installation. Call us at (832) 334-2528 to get an estimate!

## 6 Reasons Why Brick Waterproofing Fails
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/6-reasons-why-brick-waterproofing-fails/
Updated: 2026-01-09
Summary: Read this blog to learn why brick waterproofing fails, including poor preparation, wrong products, drainage issues, and how to prevent costly damage.

6 Reasons Why Brick Waterproofing Fails
Dec 30, 2025
Brick waterproofing helps reduce water absorption, but it works best when combined with proper drainage, flashing, and wall maintenance. Many homeowners apply sealers expecting long-term results, but problems like peeling, cracking, or moisture stains often show up sooner than expected.
In most cases, failure happens because of poor preparation, wrong products, or hidden structural issues. Read this blog to learn why brick waterproofing fails. This will help you avoid costly repairs and extend the life of your masonry.
1. Poor Surface Preparation
One of the biggest causes of failure is improper cleaning. Dirt, dust, grease, mold, or old coatings prevent sealers from bonding to the brick surface.
If bricks are not thoroughly cleaned—using low-pressure washing or approved brick cleaners—the waterproofing layer will peel or wash off during rain. Trapped moisture can cause blistering or surface damage when temperatures rise.
Always clean and dry bricks fully and test a small area before sealing the entire wall.
2. Using the Wrong Waterproofing Product
Not all brick sealers work the same way. Some products are not suitable for porous masonry.
Non-breathable sealers trap moisture inside the brick. This leads to:
Cracking
Flaking
Efflorescence (white powdery stains)
Brick spalling
Low-quality or improperly applied sealers may break down faster when exposed to sun and weather. Others react poorly with certain mortars or paints. The best choice is a penetrating, breathable sealer such as silane or siloxane made for exterior brick.
3. Incorrect Application Methods
Even the right product can fail if it’s applied incorrectly.
Common mistakes include:
Applying sealers in wet, hot, or windy weather.
Applying too much product at once or sealing damp brick can prevent proper absorption.
Not allowing proper curing time between coats.
Over-applying the product to damp bricks.
4. Ignoring Mortar and Structural Problems
Sealants do not fix already damaged brick walls. If you are scheduling waterproofing services and want them to work, you must first fix damaged parts such as cracked bricks, loose mortar joints or poor foundation. This will allow the waterproofing material to set and avoid problems later on.
5. Environmental and Maintenance Issues
Maintenance issues, combined with environmental factors like clogged gutters, high soil levels, poor drainage, and prolonged exposure to water or sunlight, can cause waterproofing to fail. Most products need reapplication every 5–10 years, especially in harsh climates with heavy rain or freezing temperatures.
6. Design and Drainage Flaws
If the drainage system in your house doesn’t work properly, water can pool around brick walls. Poor drainage can be caused by missing flashing, poor landscaping, and leaking downspouts. This can lead to the failure of waterproofing as water can pool and build moisture through tiny cracks.
How to Prevent Brick Waterproofing Failure
Here is how you can prevent brick waterproofing issues:
Fix drainage and moisture issues first
Repair cracks and mortar joints
Use breathable, masonry-safe sealers
Apply in proper weather conditions
Perform regular inspections
Final Thoughts
Brick waterproofing can fail for several reasons, including poor surface preparation, using the wrong product, ignoring repairs, maintenance issues, design flaws, and incorrect application.
Hire experts at Everest Siding and Windows for quick, prompt and reliable brick waterproofing without any chances of failure. To book a site visit or request an estimate, call us at (832) 334-2528 .
