## How Long Does It Take To Pressure Wash A House?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-long-does-it-take-to-pressure-wash-a-house/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: Here are some key factors which affect how long it takes to pressure wash a house. Call us for an estimate.

How Long Does It Take To Pressure Wash A House?
Nov 15, 2024
If you want to deep clean your house, pressure washing can indeed be a great way to do that. Hiring a professional pressure washing service in Houston can provide great value for money in terms of quick, effective and reliable work.
However, one thing that remains tentative is how long does it take to pressure wash a home? If your time is of great priority to you – learn about these key factors which may influence your decision!
How Long Will It Take To Pressure Wash My House?
Pressure washing a house may seem a simple and quick task but there is a lot to consider! The amount of time it takes to pressure wash a house is dependent on various factors such as:
Size of your home
Last you cleaned your house professionally
Is there algae or dirt accumulated?
Are there any hard-to-reach areas?
Equipment being used
Experience of your hired services
Additional services
Factors That Affect The Total Time Required For Pressure Washing
We will build on each of these factors below in detail!
Size Of Your House
The size of your house is a primary factor which may affect the total time needed to pressure wash. Many professional cleaning companies regard the total square foot of your house to determine the total length of a pressure washing project. Ideally, homes in the range of 155-2500 sq ft may take 1-6 hours to complete while bigger houses of 3500 sq ft and more may take up to 8 hours to completely clean.
Dirt Accumulated
Another important factor which can signify the total number of hours it may take to complete pressure washing is the amount of dirt accumulated. While estimating the total duration, professionals take into account whether your house has algae or dirt. Comparatively, a cleaner house may require less time to pressure wash.
Equipment Used
The type of equipment being used is the largest contributing factor to determine the total duration of pressure washing. Professionals who use large, contractor grade pressure washing equipment may take less time as compared to those who use small electric equipment.
Additional Services
During the pressure washing, if you request your service provider to clean the driveway, patio, deck or fence – it may add-on to the total number of hours required to complete the project.
Experience of Hired Professionals
An experienced technician may give similar results far quicker than a novice. So, if you are hiring a considerably less experienced service, make sure to log in extra time to complete the project.
Final Words
Pressure washing is great if you are considering a deep clean for your house. However, the time for each project remains tentative. The total duration might depend on the size of your house, dirt accumulated, equipment used, additional services and experience of hired professionals.
If you are a homeowner looking to get some stress of cleaning exteriors off your back and save time simultaneously. Get in touch with experts at Everest Siding and Windows for quick and reliable pressure washing in Houston, TX. Call us at (832) 334-2528 to book our services.

## How Long Does Malarkey Roofing Last on Average?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-long-does-malarkey-roofing-last-on-average/
Updated: 2026-03-16
Summary: Discover how long Malarkey roofing shingles last, what affects their lifespan, and how to maximize performance with professional installation and care.

How Long Does Malarkey Roofing Last on Average?
Feb 15, 2026
Malarkey Roofing has built a strong reputation for durability, sustainability, and advanced shingle technology. Homeowners often ask one key question: How long does Malarkey roofing last on average?
The answer depends on the product line, installation quality, and environmental conditions, but Malarkey shingles generally deliver long-lasting performance compared to many competitors.
Understanding the lifespan of Malarkey roofing helps homeowners make informed decisions, plan maintenance, and protect their investment.
Average Lifespan of Malarkey Roofing Shingles
On average, Malarkey asphalt roofing shingles last between 25 and 40 years. Architectural and premium shingles typically last longer than traditional 3-tab options.
Here’s a general breakdown:
3-Tab Shingles: 20–25 years
Architectural (Dimensional) Shingles: 30–35 years
Premium Designer Shingles: Up to 40 years with proper care
Malarkey’s Highlander, Legacy, and Vista series consistently outperform standard shingles due to advanced materials and reinforced construction.
What Makes Malarkey Roofing Last Longer?
Malarkey designs its shingles to handle everyday wear and tough weather. The brand emphasizes strength, flexibility, and long-term protection through advanced materials and design. Malarkey shingles use a specially designed asphalt blend that helps them stay flexible.
This flexibility reduces cracking and damage caused by temperature changes, wind, and impact from debris. They also include built-in protection that helps prevent dark streaks and algae buildup. This keeps the roof looking cleaner for longer while reducing surface wear over time.
Factors That Affect How Long Malarkey Roofing Lasts
While Malarkey builds durable shingles, several external factors influence how long your roof actually lasts.
Installation Quality
Professional installation plays a major role in roof lifespan. Poor ventilation, improper nailing, or skipped underlayment can significantly reduce durability.
Climate and Weather
Roofs in areas with heavy UV exposure, high winds, hail, or frequent temperature swings experience more stress. Malarkey shingles perform well in extreme conditions, but severe weather still impacts longevity.
Roof Maintenance
Routine inspections and maintenance extend roof life. Clearing debris, fixing minor issues early, and maintaining gutters prevent moisture buildup and premature wear.
Malarkey Roofing Warranties Explained
Malarkey backs its products with competitive warranties, which reflect expected performance rather than guaranteed lifespan.
Most Malarkey shingles include:
Limited Lifetime Warranty for residential use
10–15 years of non-prorated coverage, depending on the product
Wind warranties up to 130 mph with proper installation
While a warranty doesn’t guarantee your roof will last a lifetime, it provides confidence in material quality.
How to Maximize the Lifespan of Malarkey Roofing
You can help your Malarkey roof reach or exceed its average lifespan by following a few best practices:
Hire a professional roofing contractor
Schedule annual roof inspections
Address small repairs immediately
Make sure you have proper attic ventilation
Keep the roof surface clean and debris-free
Proactive care makes a noticeable difference over decades.
Is Malarkey Roofing a Long-Lasting Choice?
How long does Malarkey roofing really last on average? Most homeowners can expect 25 to 40 years of reliable performance, depending on the shingle type, installation quality, and maintenance routine.
Due to innovative materials, strong warranties, and proven durability, Malarkey roofing is a smart long-term investment. When installed correctly and properly maintained, a Malarkey roof can protect your home for decades while maintaining its appearance and structural integrity.
If you are looking for professional roofing services, Everest Siding and Windows is your go-to. Call us at (832) 334 2528 and get your roof inspected.

## How Long Does Professional Window Installation Usually Take?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-long-does-professional-window-installation-usually-take/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: Window installation can take days depending on the number of windows, their type, project complexity, previous repairs, and seasonal delays.

How Long Does Professional Window Installation Usually Take?
May 30, 2025
Professional window installation projects can span a day or even several, depending on the project’s scope and other factors. In this blog, we will outline a tentative timeline for homeowners’ reference, allowing them to align their schedules accordingly.
Typical Window Installation Based on Project Scope
Here is a general idea of window installation time based on the project scope:
Single Window
Installing a single standard window usually takes between 30 minutes and 3 hours. On average, most installations take approximately 1 to 3 hours, including the removal of the old window and adding finishing touches.
Multiple Windows
If your project involves replacing or installing multiple windows simultaneously, the timeline may vary. Here is what to expect:
A small home with 5 to 10 windows can usually be completed in one day
A medium-sized home with 10 to 20 windows typically takes 1 to 2 days
A large home with 20+ windows may take 2 to 3 days
Full Project Timeline
A complete window replacement project is more complex than you think. It can typically take between 4 and 8 weeks. This includes measuring the sizes, manufacturing, arranging delivery, and scheduling the installation.
Factors Affecting Window Installation Time
Listed below are some factors that affect the time it takes to install windows:
1. Number of Windows
The more windows you have, the longer the installation will take. For instance, a small house with one or two window replacements will be completed more quickly than larger homes with more windows, which require more time, labor, and even specialized equipment.
2. Window Type and Size
Custom or larger windows need extra time for fitting and finishing. They may require more precise measurements, adjustments, and mounting as compared to standard-sized windows.
3. Condition of Existing Frames
The condition of existing frames determines how long professional window installation may take. Repairing window frames or surrounding structures prior will add extra time to the project.
4. Labor and Experience
A skilled team with more members can typically install 10 to 15 windows in a single day, whereas a smaller or less experienced team may take longer to complete window installation.
5. Project Complexity
If your home has multiple stories, hard-to-reach areas, or specific requirements, the installation will take longer. The more complex the project, the more time it will need for planning and execution. However, simpler and accessible projects can be completed quickly.
6. Weather and Seasonal Factors
Bad weather, like rain or extreme cold, can slow down the installation process. Hence, requiring more time for professionals to wrap up the project.
How To Estimate Total Window Installation Time?
If you have a long-overdue window installation or want to align the project with other remodeling work, professionals can provide you with a personalized timeline based on your project needs. They might also add some buffer days to address manufacturing or delivery delays.
Final Word
Professional window installation can span over a day or even several. This depends on the project scope, number of windows, their type, labor and experience, project complexity, and weather-related conditions.
Get a tentative timeline specific to your project needs at Everest Siding and Windows . Call us at (832) 334-2528 .

## How Long Does Roof Cleaning Take?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-long-does-roof-cleaning-take/
Updated: 2025-10-24
Summary: Wondering how long roof cleaning will take? Learn all about the duration of the cleaning process and important factors that can affect the overall duration.

How Long Does Roof Cleaning Take?
Aug 15, 2025
Cleaning a roof is a challenging and time-consuming task, and doing it on your own might not be the best idea. Considering how complicated roof cleaning can be, it is always best for you to get trusted roof cleaning services . This way, you can get the best results without wasting any time.
However, most of the time, people wonder how long it will take for their roof to be properly cleaned. In this blog, we will learn about the duration of the roof cleaning process and explore some important factors that affect the estimated duration of the procedure.
Signs Your Roof Needs Cleaning
There are several signs that indicate the need for roof cleaning services. Ignoring the following signs can damage your roof to a great extent:
Moss and Lichen Growth: These organisms live in damp conditions and can damage the shingles of your roof.
Black Stains: Black stains can occur on your roof because of algae.
Debris: Leaves, twigs, and other debris are responsible for making the roof damp.
Damp Walls: When the roof is damp, it can also stain the walls.
Duration of Roof Cleaning
The roof cleaning process, on average, can take up to five hours. However, a standard residential roof might take less time. At the same time, a large or complex roof can take more than five hours. Sometimes it can take a few days to have a large roof cleaned properly. The same goes for roofs with heavy moss and debris.
Factors Affecting the Duration of Roof Cleaning
The following are some important factors that can affect the duration of roof cleaning:
Roof Size
Larger roofs require more time. Moreover, if the roof is steep or uniquely made, then it would affect the duration of the service.
Amount of Organic Growth
Having thick growth of algae, lichen, and moss will require multiple treatments for proper cleaning. This will extend the roof cleaning time.
Roof Material
Roofs are made from different materials. For example, if the roof is made from asphalt shingles, soft washing will be done. However, if the roof contains slate, it requires careful cleaning, which takes more time.
Weather Conditions
Conditions like humidity, rain, and snowfall can affect the drying process and interfere with the cleaning solutions.
Why Hire Professional Roof Cleaning Services?
Here is a breakdown of some major reasons why you must hire professional roof cleaning services:
Professional roof cleaning teams have the experience and knowledge to assess your roof properly.
They only use advanced tools and high-quality cleaning solutions.
Professionals have the necessary safety gear to prevent any risk.
By hiring professionals, you can efficiently have your roof cleaned.
They will identify potential issues and prevent further damage.
Final Thoughts
Roof cleaning is a time-consuming and physically challenging process. When you use DIY fixes, you might not be able to clean your roof properly. To make sure all moss and algae are removed from your roof, you need to contact a trusted roof cleaning service provider.
At Everest Siding and Windows Contractor Houston , we offer reliable and top-quality roof cleaning services to our clients. Our professional services will help improve the exterior of your home . Call us now at (832) 334-2528 for a free consultation!

## How Long Does Roof Insulation Last?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-long-does-roof-insulation-last/
Updated: 2026-06-24
Summary: Want to lower your utility bills? Find out how long roof insulation lasts and learn why pests and moisture shorten its lifespan.

How Long Does Roof Insulation Last?
Jun 15, 2026
Every homeowner cares about monthly utility costs. To protect your budget, you must ask one specific question: how long does roof insulation last? Most materials stay functional for decades, but age is not the only factor. Hidden attic damage often shortens this timeline without your knowledge.
Ignoring these hidden issues leads to expensive problems. For example, poor thermal protection causes your energy bills to climb quickly. It also places heavy stress on your heating and cooling systems. Regular attic inspections help identify these issues early and may prevent costly repairs.
Which Environmental Factors Cause Hidden Attic Damage?
Moisture damages attic insulation quickly. Prolonged moisture exposure can shorten the lifespan of certain insulation materials. Summer heat buildup also causes serious trouble when a roof lacks proper ventilation. Excessive heat, especially when combined with poor ventilation, may reduce the performance of certain insulation materials over time.
Animals also destroy attic insulation. Mice and squirrels tear up fiberglass to build nests. They leave behind waste that ruins the material. When pests walk on insulation, they flatten it. Flat insulation cannot trap air properly. This lowers the R-value of your home. A low R-value makes your heating system work much harder.
What is the Lifespan of Common Insulation Materials?
Insulation lifespans depend on the material. Fiberglass insulation can last several decades when kept dry and undisturbed. However, these sheets often sag over time. This sagging leaves empty gaps in your attic. Cellulose options only last 20 to 30 years. This recycled paper material settles down tightly. It loses thickness after two decades. This packing destroys the tiny air pockets that trap heat.
Spray foam insulation is known for its durability and can last for several decades when properly installed and maintained. It can create an effective air seal in many areas of the home. Mineral wool also handles long-term exposure well. It resists water damage easily. It keeps its original shape for decades. Homeowners must track these different schedules to prevent heat loss.
What Are the Signs of Failing Roof Insulation?
High energy bills often mean your roof insulation is failing. Your heating and cooling systems must run constantly. You might also feel drafty air inside the house. Changing temperatures between rooms show uneven coverage. Check the attic if your home loses heat fast.
Physical signs are easy to spot during an inspection. Look for bare spots on the attic floor. Check your downstairs ceilings for water stains too. Mold smells mean the material is wet. Wet insulation should be inspected promptly because prolonged moisture can reduce its effectiveness and encourage mold growth.
Final Thoughts
Good roof insulation keeps your home comfortable. Tracking its age prevents high utility bills. Do not wait for major damage to happen. Upgrading your attic material protects your HVAC system and saves money.
Ready to check your insulation? Reach out to Everest Siding and Windows , Houston at (832) 334 2528 for expert help today.

## How Much Does a 20×20 Paver Patio Cost?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-a-20x20-paver-patio-cost/
Updated: 2025-11-18
Summary: A 20x20 paver patio costs anywhere between $3,000 to over $20,000 depending on the material type, labor, installation costs and design complexity.

How Much Does a 20×20 Paver Patio Cost?
Sep 15, 2025
If you are planning to build a 20×20 paver patio, you might wonder how much it will cost. The price can range from about $3,000 to over $20,000 depending on several factors. In this blog, we will outline the estimated costs so you can budget more confidently!
Factors Influencing the Cost of a 20×20 Paver Patio
Here are some factors that can influence the cost of 20×20 Paver Patio:
1. Type of Paver Material
The type of pavers you use is one of the biggest factors in cost.
Concrete pavers are usually the most affordable. They cost about $2 to $8 per square foot. For a 400-square-foot patio, that adds up to around $800 to $3,200.
Natural stone pavers like travertine, slate, or granite are more expensive. They can cost $10 to $30 per square foot, which means $4,000 to $12,000 or more.
You will also need base materials. Sand, gravel, and landscaping fabric are needed for proper installation. These usually add $350 to $700.
Edging materials, which keep your pavers in place, can cost $100 to $300, depending on how fancy you want them.
2. Labor and Installation
Labor costs influence the final bill. Installing a paver patio involves preparing the site, laying the base, placing the pavers, and cutting them to fit.
Labor usually costs $7 to $15 per square foot.
If your site is tricky with slopes, the soil is poor, or you want a curved or multi-level patio – labor costs will automatically increase. Complex designs take more time, and skill so you are expected to pay a higher amount.
3. Design and Site Considerations
A simple rectangle is the easiest and cheapest to install. But if you want curves, steps, multiple levels, or extra features, expect costs to rise. Features like fire pits, retaining walls, or built-in seating also add to the price. So, if you want a customized and bespoke patio, get ready to pay more!
Estimated Price Ranges for Low-, Mid- And High-End Projects
Here is a general pay scale for low-, mid- and high-end projects:
Low-end projects can cost anywhere from $800 to $3,200. This usually covers basic concrete pavers and simple installation.
Mid-range projects can be priced anywhere between $7,500 to $13,000. This includes better-quality materials and more detailed designs.
High-end projects are most expensive costing $13,000 to $20,000 or more. This is for premium natural stone, tricky sites, or complex custom designs.
How to Lower the Costs of Your Patio Project?
Here is how you can reduce the total project cost without compromising on quality:
Choose concrete pavers. They are cheaper but come in many colors and patterns so you can go all out with your vision
Keep the patio design simple i.e., square or rectangle
Request quotes from multiple service providers to get the best price possible
Buying material in bulk can reduce cost per unit
Final Thoughts
A 20×20 paver patio can cost anywhere from $3,000 to over $20,000 depending on the paver material, labor charges and custom requirements. Simple designs require less labor and cost less than tricky patio designs with additional features like fire pits, retaining walls or built-in seating.
Give your patio vision to our experts at Everest Siding and Windows to work out the best prices possible or call us at (832) 334-2528 to schedule a site visit.

## How Much Does It Cost To Get A New Siding?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-it-cost-to-get-a-new-siding/
Updated: 2024-08-08
Summary: Siding ultimately protects your home from external stimuli, be it insect infestation or weather issues, there is a lot that siding does.

How Much Does It Cost To Get A New Siding?
Jan 15, 2024
Siding ultimately protects your home from external stimuli, be it insect infestation or weather issues, there is a lot that siding does. It doesn’t just boost your curb appeal but also shields your house from harsh weather conditions, prevents water damage, and provides insulation.
However, in order to keep your home’s safety defenses up, it is necessary to upgrade your sideboards, especially once their time is up. But before you make a hasty purchase, you need to know how much a new siding costs. Usually, siding costs somewhere around $10,000 to $15,000. To learn about the different types of siding and their costs, keep reading this blog.
Types of Siding
There are various types of siding you can choose from, especially when you’re looking to remodel and upgrade your home. Take a look below to see some of the different siding options.
Vinyl Siding
Known for its durability, low maintenance, and versatility, vinyl siding is one of the most popular choices. There are plenty of colors and styles to choose from, fit for any aesthetic you might be looking for.
Fiber Cement
Fiber cement siding is extremely strong. It is also resistant to fire, insects, and mold since it combines the strength of cement as well as wood.
Hardie Plank
Hardie plank siding is highly durable, regardless of the weather or other external elements. Moreover, there is also a long warranty period that can extend to up to 30 years.
Wood Siding
For a timeless and natural look, wood siding is an excellent choice. While it requires more maintenance, its authentic appeal makes it a favorite among homeowners.
Metal Siding
If you want a more modern option, then metal siding is the one for you. It is incredibly sturdy and can withstand rot as well as insect infestation. However, it does tend to be a little more expensive than others.
LP Smartside
Made from strong hardwood, LP smartside is a premium siding option. The best part about it is that it is long-lasting and can provide up to 50 years of warranty.
How Much Does New Siding Cost?
The cost of new siding varies based on factors such as the material, the size of your home, and labor expenses, among other things. On average, you can expect to spend around $10,000 to $15,000 for a 2,500-square-foot home. However, it can also range as low as $8,000 and go up to over $50,000.
Siding costs are also calculated according to the square foot and shape of your home. The prices may also fluctuate based on your location and the service providers. Thus, to get the best price estimate, reach out to professional contractors in your area.
Long Story Short
Investing in new siding is quite a big step since it takes years for a siding to give out. When choosing a material, pay close attention to the durability, aesthetic value, and cost of the siding. Contact Everest Siding and Windows at (832) 334-2528 to get an accurate quote on eco-friendly siding options for your house.

## How Much Does It Cost to Power Wash a House in Houston, TX?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-it-cost-to-power-wash-a-house-in-houston-tx/
Updated: 2024-08-08
Summary: It costs around $400 to power wash a house. But it can be anywhere from $200 to $1,250, depending on your house size, linear feet, and stories.

How Much Does It Cost to Power Wash a House in Houston, TX?
Apr 30, 2024
Every homeowner needs to clean their house. While water and soap work fine for light dirt, they might not cut it for tough dirt. That’s when power washing comes in handy. It’s a powerful way to clean stubborn grime and make your house look almost new.
Now, to a big concern: “How much does it cost to power wash a house?” It depends on various factors, such as your property’s size. In Houston, Texas, the typical price to power wash a house is about $500. For a house between 1,500 and 2,000 square feet, the cost usually falls between $370 and $640.
Why Is Power Washing So Expensive?
Most of the cost of power washing a house goes into paying for labor. Water and cleaning agents, if needed, are usually not too expensive. So, the hourly rate your professional charges will greatly impact your total bill.
How Much Does It Cost To Power Wash A 2,500 Sq Ft House?
Power washing a house usually costs around $400 for a two-story house that’s about 2,500 square feet. The price changes based on the house’s size and its many stories.
For example, if your house is three stories tall and 3,000 square feet, the cost can go up to $1,250. Smaller houses, like a 2,300-square-foot one, might cost between $200 and $250, depending on their size and shape.
What Factors Impact the Cost of Power Washing a House?
The cost of power washing a house can be influenced by various factors, such as the house’s size, how dirty it is, what areas you want cleaned, and the time of year. The type of siding you have usually doesn’t affect the cost, but it does determine the cleaning method used.
House Size
The main factor affecting the cost is the size of the house. This includes the length of the house and the number of floors. Companies use these details to figure out how much time, resources, and cleaning supplies they will need.
Dirtiness
Different parts of your house might be extra dirty. For example, your driveway could have oil stains, or your roof could have moss. Cleaning these spots might require more work, extra money, and sometimes even special chemicals.
Items Getting Cleaned
Sometimes, when you get your house power washed, you might also want other things cleaned, like gutters, driveways, or fences. Each extra thing adds to the cost. But if you get them all done together, it might cost less than doing them separately.
Time of Year
The time of year can also affect the cost. In some places, power washing companies are busier during the summer, so they might charge more. But if you get it done during slower times, it might be cheaper.
Concluding Thoughts
Power washing is a part of your annual home maintenance. It increases your home value and curbs its appeal for years. If you are also worried about” How much does it cost to power wash a house?” it can be affordable, as it lasts a long time.
Visit Richard and his certified team at Everest Siding and Windows . We use smart methods to make sure your property is completely clean and free from any dirt, grime, or harmful stuff. For the best, call Everest at (832) 334-2528 .

## How Much Does It Cost To Replace Windows On Your Home?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-it-cost-to-replace-windows-on-your-home/
Updated: 2024-12-23
Summary: The average cost of window replacement can vary and reach between $300 to $1800. Read on to our blog and find how to estimate the cost with good deal

How Much Does It Cost To Replace Windows On Your Home?
Jul 15, 2024
If your home is feeling uncomfortable and cold then this is one of the indications that you need window replacement. Installing a window is a very expensive project, but the outcome always leads to giving a vibrant look to your exterior appearance and at the same time assist in reducing your energy bills.
If you have done some research on how much does it cost to replace windows on your home the answers you may get are not straightforward as they should be. The reason is that there are multiple factors which are involved in the process of window replacement cost. In our blog we will help you break all down and understand what should be your main focus for this side of the home renovation project.
Signs Indicating Need For Window Replacement
There are many signs which lay the ground for the window replacement:
The most obvious one is damaged windows. The glass gets foggy easily and leads to visibility issues.
There can be chipped or cracked panes which can make the windows less energy efficient. This reason is quite threatening as any intruder can enter your house taking advantage of these cracked panes.
Windows when not energy efficient, you may face skyrocketing heating bills which can be the result of substandard installation.
Old windows may allow UV light inside the home which may fade away floor, wallpaper or furniture colors.
What Is The Estimated Cost Per Window Replacement?
As per the latest survey, the average cost per window replacement is around $300. You might need to pay for it between $300 to $ 1800. The increase and decrease in the cost may be due to the type of window and frame you choose along with the labor rates as per the area you reside in.
The idea of having funds and then opting for the replacement and installation of the window is a must so you can afford your other expenses too.
Low Cost of Window Replacing: $300

High Cost of Window Replacing: $1800
Primary Factors Involved In Cost Of Window Replacement
There are many questions which keep bugging your mind when you decide on replacing the windows. They all need good answering. You need to look into many factors when calculating the cost and believe us that every variable needs to be addressed.
There is a detailed research process which needs serious attention followed by consulting with a remodeling contractor in your area. This is how you will be able to cater to the needs and expectations.

Material
Size
Type
Glass Type
Number of Windows Needs Replacement
Labor & Installation
Brand Choice
And More..
What To Keep In Mind When Determining Which Windows Are Right?
There are many things you need to keep in mind as this is not something which you will go for in near future again. So making a choice should be thoroughly dived into with different options available. The following questions need to be observed carefully:
Can I get the same matching windows with the overall home design?
What type of installation will be best?
What type of warranty should I look for?
What is the process and how many days it takes for a project to complete?
Can I expect an additional fee which I should be aware of?
Summing Up

## How Much Does Roof Cleaning Cost?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-roof-cleaning-cost/
Updated: 2025-10-24
Summary: Roof cleaning costs range between $1,000 to $3,000 based on roof size, cleaning method, roof material, etc.

How Much Does Roof Cleaning Cost?
Feb 15, 2025
Roof cleaning is an essential home improvement task. It not only improves your roof’s appearance but also extends its lifespan by keeping it safe from dust, debris, and algae buildup. Depending on the roof size, cleaning method, roof material, and other factors, professional roof cleaning services may charge per hour or offer complete packages.
In this blog, we will discuss the average price for roof cleaning to give you a better idea.
What Is The Average Cost of Roof Cleaning?
You can expect to pay anywhere between $1,000 to $3,500 for a 1,500-square-foot roof. However, the price may fluctuate based on various factors that we will discuss further in this blog.
Roof Cleaning Cost By Roof Size
As a rule of thumb, almost every professional roof cleaning service is charged by square foot. This means that the final price is directly proportional to the roof size. If you have a larger roof, you will have a relatively higher amount compared to clients with smaller roof sizes.
Roof Cleaning Cost By Cleaning Method
Another thing that determines the final price is the roof cleaning method. Here are some types of roof cleaning methods:
Blower cleaning: It is the simplest and cheapest among all roof cleaning options. A blower is used to clean debris and accumulated dust.
Chemical wash cleaning: This type targets mold, lichen, and mildew using special cleaning agents.
Pressure washing: It is a popular roof cleaning method that uses high-pressure water to remove dirt, mildew, and mold from roofs.
Soft wash roof cleaning: This is a versatile yet expensive method combining low-pressure, chemical, and manual cleaning.
Roof Cleaning Cost By Roof Material
The roofing material is another determinant of final cleaning costs. Materials like asphalt shingles, clay, concrete, and slate are more expensive to clean than gravel, metal, and rubber as they require more labor.
Roof Cleaning Cost By Stories
Houses with multiple stories can have higher roof cleaning costs because they require extra safety, equipment, and protection. You might be expected to pay $0.10 more per square foot for each additional story.
Roof Cleaning Cost By Labour
Professionals handle roof cleaning the best, and l abor costs amount to a major chunk. Although most professionals charge by size, others might charge per hour.
Additional Costs To Consider
Many companies offer add-on services to the basic cleaning package, such as:
Moss removal
Gutter cleaning
Roof coating
Stain removal
Solar panel cleaning
Roof repairs
How To Save Money On Roof Cleaning?
If you are considering hiring roof cleaning services, here is how to save some bucks:
Compare multiple costs and see which one fits your budget best.
Look for seasonal discounts or package deals.
Regular cleaning can be less expensive and make cleaning easier.
Look for sealants or coating options to reduce the frequency of roof cleaning.
Final Words
Roof cleaning costs average $1,000 to $3,000 based on your roof size, labor cost, cleaning method, roof material, and number of stories. Get an estimate from our professional roof cleaners at Everest Siding and Windows , or call us at (832) 334-2528 for prompt answers.

## How Much Does Roof Insulation Cost?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-roof-insulation-cost/
Updated: 2024-12-24
Summary: Roof insulation prices keep varying. However, on average, it can cost you somewhere around $1000 to $5000 for a full roof insulation.

How Much Does Roof Insulation Cost?
Feb 29, 2024
With the seasonal changes coming your way, it is essential to make sure your home is well-insulated from top to bottom. This is especially true when it comes to your roof, as it helps maintain comfort and boosts your property value.
Moreover, roof insulation doesn’t just help regulate indoor temperatures but also plays a significant role in lowering your energy bills.
However, before starting any home improvement project, it is crucial to budget through the total cost. That is why in this blog, we have broken down everything you need to know about the cost of roof insulation.
Deciphering the exact cost of roof installation can be a little tricky, as there are numerous factors that affect the price. Most importantly, the state you live in, the type of roof insulation, and the size of the roof are what’s most important.
Additionally, the cost of roof insulation is also calculated according to the square foot of the material used. Mentioned below is a list of some of the most common types of insulation and their average price.
Fiberglass Insulation — $0.50 to $2.50 per square foot
Loose Fill Insulation — $1.00 to $3.00 per square foot
Rigid Foam Insulation — $0.50 – $2.00 per square foot
Spray Foam Insulation — $0.25 to $2.00 per square foot
Radiant Barrier Insulation — $0.50 to $3.00 per square foot
Although when totaled based on 1,000 square feet, you can expect roof insulation to cost roughly between $1,000 to $5,000.
Factors Affecting Roof Insulation Costs
There are numerous factors that tend to influence the cost of roof insulation, such as:
Size of The Roof
Larger roofs require more materials and labor, which leads to higher expenses. Plus, roofs with tricky angles or other unique features may require extra work, further impacting the cost.
Type of Insulation Material
There are many different types of insulation materials available, each with its own cost value. Often, people use fiberglass, rigid foam, and spray foam, but other options are also available, depending on your personal preferences.
Labor Costs
Labor costs for roof insulation installation might increase or decrease based on location, contractor rates, and project complexity. Hiring experienced professionals is crucial to ensure proper installation and maximize energy savings in the long run.
Final Words
Investing in roof insulation may not seem as important, but it is a wise decision that can improve your home’s comfort, energy efficiency, and overall value.
While the initial cost may seem overwhelming, always make sure to consult a professional to get a quote. This way, you will have an idea of how much roof insulation will cost and whether or not it aligns with your budget.
For more information on the matter or to get an expert’s opinion, feel free to contact Everest Siding and Windows at (832) 334-2528 .

## How Much Does Siding Cost For A 2,000 Sq Ft House?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-much-does-siding-cost-for-a-2000-sq-ft-house/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: On average, the siding cost for 2,000 sq ft homes is around $15,000 or more based on several factors like material type, labor cost, etc.

How Much Does Siding Cost For A 2,000 Sq Ft House?
Apr 15, 2025
If you are looking to enhance your home’s curb appeal and protection against outdoor elements, replacing your siding can be a great option. However, like every home improvement project, replacing siding also needs a sizable budget, especially for 2,000 sq ft homes or larger.
We are here to provide all the relevant information on how much siding replacement costs for a 2,000 sq ft home, discussing factors that may influence the final cost. Keep reading to get your answers!
Average Cost of Siding A 2,000 Sq Ft House
On average, replacing the siding of a 2,000 sq ft house can cost around $15,000 or more. This price can fluctuate on the basis of your siding material choice, installation complexity, and other factors that we will discuss in detail later on.
Siding Cost Based on Material Choices
Here’s a cost breakdown of siding installation based on different materials:
Vinyl Siding
Vinyl siding is a budget-friendly option, costing between $3.50 and $12 per square foot. For a 2,000 sq. ft. home, the total cost ranges from $7,000 to $24,000.
Fiber Cement
Fiber cement or Hardie Plank siding costs between $4.70 and $8.50 per square foot, with a total cost ranging from $9,400 to $17,000 for a 2,000-square-foot home.
Wood Siding
Wood siding is a natural and aesthetically pleasing option, priced between $7.50 and $14 per square foot. A 2,000 sq. ft. home will cost between $15,000 and $28,000 to outfit with wood siding.
Engineered Wood Siding
Engineered wood siding ranges from $7 to $12 per square foot, totaling $14,000 to $24,000 for a 2,000 sq. ft. home.
Aluminum Siding
Aluminum siding is priced between $4.50 and $6 per square foot, with a total cost for a 2,000 sq. ft. home ranging from $9,000 to $12,000.
Factors Influencing the Price of Siding Replacement
Let’s look at the factors that can influence the price of siding replacement for homeowners:
Material Choice
The type of siding you choose plays a big role in the cost. Vinyl is the most affordable option, while materials like brick and stone veneer are significantly more expensive. Each option has its balance of price, durability, and maintenance needs.
Labor Costs
Labor costs depend on your location, the contractor’s experience, and the complexity of the job. More complex projects, such as multi-story homes or custom designs, require more labor; hence, they come with higher costs.
Home Size and Design
The bigger and more complex your home is, the more it will cost to replace the siding. Larger or multi-story homes require more materials and extra labor, which increases the price.
Local Permits
Many places require permits for siding replacement, and the cost can vary based on local rules. Make sure to check if permits are needed before starting work.
Additional Repairs
Extra repairs may be needed before installing new siding if your home is old or has structural damage. Issues like water damage or rot behind the old siding can add to the total cost.
Location
Your geographic location can influence the cost of siding replacement. Labor rates and material availability can differ from one area to another. Hence, checking market rates is essential for your location.
Final Words
Replacing siding for 2,000 sq ft homes costs $15,000 or more on average. However, this price can vary based on several factors, including material type, labor costs, home size and design, additional repairs, permits, and your location.
Get an estimate from our siding contractors at Everest Siding and Windows at (832) 334-2528 .

## How New Siding Can Completely Transform Your Houston Home’s Curb Appeal
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-new-siding-can-completely-transform-your-houston-homes-curb-appeal/
Updated: 2026-10-28
Summary: Upgrade your Houston home’s curb appeal with new siding. Improve appearance, durability, and value with expert installation you can trust.

How New Siding Can Completely Transform Your Houston Home’s Curb Appeal
Mar 30, 2026
If you live in Houston, you already know how quickly the outside of a home can start to look worn. Heat, humidity, heavy rain, and strong sunlight all take a toll on exterior materials over time. One of the most effective ways to refresh and completely transform the look of a house is new siding.
A properly installed siding system does more than improve appearance. It can redefine the entire character of a home, making it look newer, cleaner, and more valuable from the street.
At Everest Siding and Windows , homeowners often share that new siding feels like getting a brand new house without changing the structure itself. Here is how siding creates such a powerful transformation.
First impressions change everything
Curb appeal is the first thing people notice when they see a home. Old siding that is faded, cracked, or uneven can make even a well maintained house look neglected.
New siding instantly improves this first impression by creating a clean and consistent exterior surface. Fresh materials and updated colors make the home stand out in a positive way, especially in established Houston neighborhoods where homes may be decades old.
Color choice completely reshapes the home’s identity
One of the most dramatic changes comes from color selection. Modern siding options allow homeowners to move away from outdated tones and choose colors that better match current design trends.
Lighter shades can make a home feel larger and more open. Deeper tones can add richness and a more modern appearance. In Houston, many homeowners choose colors that also reflect heat and help maintain a cooler exterior surface.
Even a simple change in color can make a home look newly built.
New siding improves texture and visual depth
Older siding often loses texture due to weather exposure. It may appear flat, faded, or uneven. New siding brings back definition and structure to exterior walls.
Materials like fiber cement and modern vinyl options are designed to hold texture and resist warping. This gives the home a sharper and more refined look from the street.
The added visual depth makes the property look more expensive and well maintained.
It corrects years of weather damage
Houston weather is demanding on exterior materials. High humidity can cause swelling, while sun exposure leads to fading and brittleness over time. Rain and moisture can also contribute to staining and surface damage.
New siding covers these imperfections and restores a smooth exterior surface. This alone can dramatically improve curb appeal because the home looks structurally sound and well cared for again.
Clean lines make a home look newer
Modern siding installation focuses heavily on alignment and precision. Straight lines, tight joints, and consistent panel spacing all contribute to a polished appearance.
Even older homes can look newly constructed when the exterior is properly updated. This effect is especially noticeable in neighborhoods where many houses were built decades ago.
It increases perceived property value
While curb appeal is visual, it also influences how people perceive value. A home with new siding often appears more expensive and better maintained than similar homes without exterior updates.
This matters whether you plan to stay in the home or sell it in the future. Buyers often make quick judgments based on exterior condition before they ever step inside.
Better materials mean longer lasting beauty
Modern siding materials are designed to resist fading, moisture damage, and cracking. This means the improved appearance lasts for years with minimal maintenance.
Many Houston homeowners prefer materials that can handle temperature changes and humidity without losing their look. This helps the home maintain strong curb appeal over time, not just immediately after installation.
Real homeowner experiences in Houston
Homeowners consistently mention a few key improvements after replacing siding. They notice better communication during the project, cleaner job sites, and careful inspections before final completion.
They also highlight how small details, such as correcting minor imperfections and ensuring proper finishing, make a noticeable difference in the final appearance of the home.
These experiences show that the transformation is not only visual but also tied to the quality of workmanship behind the installation.
Final thoughts
New siding is one of the most effective ways to completely change how a Houston home looks from the outside. It improves color, texture, structure, and overall presentation in a way few other upgrades can match.
For homeowners looking to enhance curb appeal and restore pride in their property, siding replacement delivers one of the most noticeable transformations possible.
If you are considering upgrading your home exterior, working with an experienced local team like Everest Siding and Windows ensures the result is not only visually appealing but also built to last in Houston’s demanding climate.

## How Often Should You Check Your Windows for Leaks?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-often-should-you-check-your-windows-for-leaks/
Updated: 2026-03-16
Summary: Inspect your windows every 1–3 years, or after storms, to catch leaks early and prevent drafts, water damage, mold, and high energy bills.

How Often Should You Check Your Windows for Leaks?
Oct 30, 2025
You’re sitting by the window, enjoying a warm cup of coffee while watching the beautiful sunset — but then you feel a cool draft sneaking in. That little breeze might seem small, but it could be a sign that your window is leaking. Window leaks often go unnoticed until they cause bigger problems, like water damage, mold, or rising energy bills. So, it is best to keep checking them regularly.
In this blog, we will discuss how often you should inspect your windows and what signs to watch out for!
Frequency of Checking Windows for Leaks
Homeowners should visually check windows at least once a year, ideally at the start of each heating or cooling season (spring and fall). Minor checks like feeling for drafts or inspecting caulk should be done annually. This helps you catch small issues before they turn into expensive repairs. Professional inspections can be carried out for newer windows every 2-3 years in mild climates.
However, the exact timing can vary depending on a few factors:
Age of your windows: If your windows are more than 10 to 15 years old, check them once a year. Older materials wear out faster and are more likely to develop leaks. Wood and aluminum windows may require more frequent checks due to expansion, contraction, and potential moisture issues.
Climate conditions: Homes in coastal or windy areas, or places that face heavy storms, should schedule annual inspections. Harsh weather can damage seals and frames.
Recent installations: Caulk and sealant can settle or shrink after installation, so re-checking the perimeter after the first seasonal change (around 6 months) is a good idea.
After severe weather events: Storms, hail, or strong winds can cause hidden window damage. After such events, it’s a good idea to do a quick inspection.
Signs Your Windows Might Be Leaking
Here is a list of signs that indicate that your window might be leaking:
Drafts or cold air near windows.
Sudden spikes in your energy bills.
Condensation between panes usually means the glass seal has failed, not necessarily a frame leak, but it still requires repair or glass replacement.
Uneven indoor temperatures.
If you notice any of these, it’s time to inspect your windows more closely.
How to Check for Leaks in Windows
In order to check your windows for leaks, homeowners can perform a smoke or candle test on windy days or use an infrared thermometer to spot temperature changes near frames. Look at both the inside and outside edges of your windows. Check for:
Gaps between the frame and the wall
Cracked or peeling caulk
Worn-out seals
If you see any of the following, it is best to call a professional to resolve this issue.
Why Early Detection Matters
Fixing leaks in windows early helps you:
Keep your home energy-efficient
Prevent mold and water damage
Extend the lifespan of your windows
Avoid costly repairs or replacements
Final Words
Windows can develop leaks over time. Checking your windows for leaks is an easy way to keep your home safe and comfortable. A quick look in the spring and fall can help you catch small problems early before they turn into big repairs. Some signs that may indicate a window leak are rising energy bills, inconsistent temperatures, and condensation between window panes .
If you suspect that your window might be leaking and you need a replacement, call Everest Siding and Windows for quick, reliable, and transparent services. To book a site visit or request an estimate, call us at (832) 334-2528 .

## How Often Should You Pressure Wash Your Driveway?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-often-should-you-pressure-wash-your-driveway/
Updated: 2026-03-16
Summary: Read this blog to find out how often you should pressure wash your driveway, depending on climate, traffic, usage, and driveway material. Once a year is ideal.

How Often Should You Pressure Wash Your Driveway?
Nov 30, 2025
A clean driveway instantly lifts the look of your home. It’s one of the first things guests notice, and plays a role in your property’s overall curb appeal. Beyond appearances, if you want to maintain your property value, pressure washing once in a year or two helps keep your outdoor space looking fresh.
If you’ve ever wondered whether you should pressure wash your driveway, this blog breaks everything down so you can maintain your driveway without stress. Read further to find out important details about pressure washing your driveway!
Why Pressure Washing Your Driveway Matters
Over time, dirt, oil, mold, mildew, and other contaminants settle into the surface of your driveway. These make the area look dull, create slippery patches, and may even weaken the material underneath. Pressure washing removes this buildup, protects your driveway from long-term damage, and ensures a clean, safe space for your family and visitors.
How Often Should You Pressure Wash?
Most homeowners can safely pressure wash their driveway once in a year or two. This cleaning removes typical dirt, grime, and surface stains that naturally accumulate over time. Contaminant buildup can weaken materials; pressure washing helps prevent this by removing harmful deposits.
However, some homeowners may need to wash more often depending on where they live and the condition of their driveway.
Factors That Affect How Often You Need to Pressure Wash
Here is a list of factors that affect how often you need to pressure wash your driveway:
1. Climate and Weather Conditions
Your climate plays one of the biggest roles in determining how often you need to pressure wash.
Humid Climates:
In humid or shaded areas prone to mildew, washing your driveway every 6–12 months is recommended.
Dry Climates:
Homes in dry, dusty areas typically only need pressure washing once a year unless you notice heavy dust accumulation.
Snowy Regions:
Salt from winter roads can stain and degrade driveways. If you experience snow and ice often, washing the driveway after winter is a good idea.
2. Traffic and Usage
The level of use your driveway gets also affects cleaning frequency:
High vehicle and foot traffic
Frequent oil or fluid leaks
Mud from gardens, pets, or off-road vehicles
Parking of heavy equipment or boats
Heavy-use driveways may benefit from 2 cleanings per year.
3. Driveway Material
The frequency of driveway pressure washing also depends on the material. Here is a simple breakdown for reference:
Concrete: Strong, durable, and can be pressure-washed yearly or semi-yearly.
Asphalt: Softer than concrete—requires gentle care, so annually is fine. Asphalt should only be washed with low pressure to avoid surface damage.
Pavers: Can be cleaned yearly but may need extra attention if weeds or moss grow between the joints.
Sealed Driveways: Stay cleaner longer and may need less frequent washing.
Hiring a Professional for Driveway Washing
A professional pressure washing is always a better idea than doing it on your own. Professionals are ideal if you want deeper cleaning, have a delicate driveway surface, or prefer a hassle-free experience. They have the right tools to do it safely without damaging your house.
Final Thoughts
Pressure washing is a simple yet effective way to clean your driveway of settled debris and stains. Ideally, homeowners should consider hiring this service once a year. However, this depends on the climate, traffic, usage, and driveway material.
If you are looking to hire us for siding, windows, roofing, etc., try our add-on pressure washing service. Reach out to Everest Siding and Windows for quick, and reliable services. To book a site visit or request an estimate, call us at (832) 334-2528 .

## How Often Should You Schedule Siding Cleaning Service?
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-often-should-you-schedule-siding-cleaning-service/
Updated: 2025-11-18
Summary: Not sure how often to clean your siding? Find expert tips on the right schedule to protect your home and keep it looking new.

How Often Should You Schedule Siding Cleaning Service?
Aug 30, 2025
Keeping your home’s exterior clean is just as important as maintaining the inside. One of the most visible parts of your home’s exterior is the siding. Over time, dirt, mold, algae, and other pollutants build up on siding, which can damage its look and shorten its lifespan. That’s why regular siding cleaning is a must. But how often should you do it? Let’s answer relevant questions in this blog!
Factors That Affect Siding Cleaning Frequency
Several things influence how often you need to clean your siding, including:
1. Type of Siding Material
Different siding materials need different care. Vinyl and aluminum usually need cleaning every 1–2 years. Wood is more delicate, so it should be cleaned every 6–12 months. In contrast, fiber cement needs cleaning every 12–18 months while brick or stucco needs cleaning every 3–5 years.
2. Climate and Weather
Your local climate affects how often you should opt for professional siding cleaning services. Humid or rainy areas provide favorable conditions for mold and mildew to grow faster. Dusty or polluted regions also cause dirt and grime to build up quickly, requiring regular cleanup.
3. Shade and Vegetation
Homes with lots of trees or plants nearby are more likely to get algae, mold, and leaf buildup. Shade also keeps siding damp longer, making it easier for mildew to grow. This means more frequent cleaning is needed.
4. Proximity to Roads
If your home is near a busy road or construction site, dust and dirt can stick to the siding faster. These pollutants can make your siding look dull and dirty. In such cases, cleaning twice a year is recommended.
5. Storms or Damage
Extreme weather like storms, wildfires, or heavy winds can leave your siding covered in dirt, ash, or debris. Cleaning after these events is important to prevent stains and damage. This keeps your siding in good condition over the years.
Signs Your Siding Needs Cleaning Sooner
You may not always stick to a set schedule. Watch for these signs:
Visible dirt or discoloration
Mold, mildew, or algae spots
Musty smell near walls
Tree sap, bird droppings, or other stains
Peeling or flaking paint
Benefits of Regular Siding Cleaning
Cleaning your siding regularly helps:
Extend the life of siding and prevent rot
Keep your home looking fresh and attractive
Protect against water damage from mold or mildew
Maintain energy efficiency in homes
Boost curb appeal and home value
Final Thoughts
There’s no standard answer to how often siding should be cleaned – it depends on your siding type, local climate, and environment. For most homes, once a year or every two years is ideal. If your home is in a humid, shaded, or high-dust area, consider cleaning twice a year.

## How Professional Siding and Brick Cleaning Restores Your Home’s Curb Appeal
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-professional-siding-and-brick-cleaning-restores-your-homes-curb-appeal/
Updated: 2026-08-04
Summary: Dirt, algae, and pollution dull a home's exterior over time. See how professional siding and brick cleaning brings back color and curb appeal.

How Professional Siding and Brick Cleaning Restores Your Home’s Curb Appeal
Jul 30, 2026
Siding and brick rarely look as good five years in as they did on day one. Dirt, algae, mildew, and everyday pollution work their way into the surface, dulling a look that once stood out. Professional cleaning restores it, giving a home’s exterior a refresh that a garden hose or manual scrubbing usually can’t achieve on their own.
Why Your Home’s Exterior Loses Its Clean Appearance
Exteriors wear down simply from being outside. Dust settles into every crevice, and algae or mildew finds damp corners to grow, especially in shaded or humid spots. Add in years of airborne pollution, streaks left behind by rain, and organic debris like leaves and pollen, and the residue accumulates fast.
None of this happens overnight, which is part of the problem. It builds slowly enough that a home can end up looking noticeably older than it actually is, without anyone quite noticing when the shift happened.
How Professional Cleaning Revives Siding and Brick
A proper cleaning targets the grime that’s settled deep into the surface, not just what’s sitting on top, which is why it holds up longer than a quick rinse would. Once that residue is gone, the original color underneath tends to show through again, often looking noticeably brighter than before.
Professional siding and brick cleaning also covers spots that typical upkeep misses, like high corners, tight trim lines, and areas tucked behind landscaping. Brick and siding don’t respond the same way to cleaning.
Brick can lose mortar under high pressure, so most professionals use soft washing instead. Siding can usually handle more pressure, but a controlled pass still works better than raw power. When done correctly, cleaning leaves the exterior looking restored, not just rinsed off.
The Curb Appeal Benefits of a Cleaner Exterior
A cleaned exterior does more than look nice up close. It can shift the first impression a home makes, both to visitors pulling into the driveway and to anyone just passing by.
Landscaping stands out more when the home’s exterior is free of dirt and staining. The whole property appears better maintained. Cleaning brings a personal benefit as well. Homeowners often feel a renewed sense of pride once the exterior looks the way it did when the home was newer, something easy to overlook when the shift happens slowly.
When It’s Time to Schedule Professional Cleaning
A few signs indicate it’s time:
Noticeable discoloration across siding or brick
Green or black streaks that keep coming back
Dirt that won’t rinse away with a hose
An exterior that looks dull next to neighboring homes
Getting ready for guests, a sale, or seasonal upkeep
Conclusion
A clean exterior can change how a home looks and feels more than people often realize. If your siding or brick needs a refresh, contact Everest Siding and Windows at (832) 334-2528 to schedule a cleaning.

## How to Choose a Home Improvement Contractor
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-to-choose-a-home-improvement-contractor/
Updated: 2024-12-24
Summary: Learn key tips for selecting the perfect home improvement contractor to ensure quality, reliability, and a stress-free project!

How to Choose a Home Improvement Contractor
Aug 26, 2019
Most of the time, your home is the biggest investment you make during your life time. Moreover, this is the place that protects your family and your valuables– tangible or intangible. So it makes sense that when comes to maintaining it to be as careful and thorough as you can be and choose a product that will guarantee the security and durability you and your family need and a contractor that can make it all happen on time and on budget.
Each year thousands of Houston metro homeowners hire a contractor to improve or remodel their home. While most consumers are satisfied with the work done by their contractor, others complain about careless workmanship, overcharges during the process, missed deadlines or the contractor’s failure to complete the work. Some even complain that the contractor failed to start the project at all.So what can and should you do to protect yourself from running into trouble when remodeling your home?
Do your homework
Now-a-days, there is a lot of information online you can read to familiarize yourself with the type of project you are planning to undertake. What products are available? How are they rated? Who offers them? Are there any issues with those products that you should be aware of? While you expect your contractor to give you most off this information, having a little bit of knowledge helps you weed out the pros from the amateurs.Visit home improvement centers, showrooms, read magazines, browse the Internet and talk to others who have completed similar renovations.
Plan ahead
Think about what you want and what you can afford. Figure in all the costs, including materials, supplies, labor, permits, and financing. Create a workable, realistic budget. Plan on how you want to pay for your project. Can you afford to pay it all with savings or you consider financing it? Is a home line of credit available or you need a contractor that offers finance plans?
Choose a contractor
This is a very important part of your project and there are many things to consider before you sign on the dotted line. Choosing the right contractor can make the difference between a successful home renovation project and a disaster.
Shop around. Try to get recommendations from people you know: your friends, neighbors, and colleagues at work. Good contractors are usually found by word of mouth.
Get at least three estimates from different companies, especially if your project is a large one. Listen to their presentation; all of them have a different approach to project management and offer different products. Make sure all estimates are based on the same set of specifications, materials and scope of work. Be sure the estimates include details and specifications, responsibility for clean up, and amount of downpayment required. In assessing the estimates, don’t always go with the low bidder. A higher price may be worth it if the contractor is the most experienced, will use better materials, will do a better job, and keep to a timeline. Be wary of an extremely low bid. It may be an indication that the contractor is overeager for your business, made a mistake in preparing the bid or is not including all the work quoted by the other bidders.
Ask for proof of insurance. Home improvement contractors should have insurance to cover all the unforeseen events that do happen from time to time during a home improvement project, such as personal accidents or damage to the property. Ask your consultant to provide proof of insurance before signing anything.
Make sure they have been in business for more than a few months. Generally speaking, the longer the better, but don’t discount newer companies. They tend to go the extra mile to prove they are serious about their business.
Ask about similar past and current projects similar to yours.
Ask for their business address. Verify this information, and remember – a contractor who only gives a P.O. box address may be difficult to find if the job goes uncompleted or you need him to come back to fix something after the last bill has been paid. Check for work from home companies as well, as that may be a sign to be concerned.
If your project requires a permit- and most of them do, ask the contractor if they take care of the needed permits. Be suspicious if the contractor asks you to get the permit – it could mean that the contractor doesn’t represent a registered business and does not want to contact the local building authorities.
Ask questions about the process once the project starts. Will they check on the work regularly? Do they have a designated project manager? Will they take care of unforeseen issues? Do you have access to an upper management/owner if things don’t go the way they should?
Understand the estimate you are given. Make sure the price covers everything so you don’t run into surprises during the project.
Get a written contract
Contracts for jobs costing $500 or more must be in writing, but it’s best to get a written contract in all cases. Insist on a written contract, and make sure to get a copy. Do NOT agree to an oral contract. By law, the contract must include :
The complete name, address, and phone number of the contractor
Specific description of the work and materials, including brands, model numbers and other identifying information, along with the price
Clarification on who obtains and pays for permits
A requirement that the contractor remove and cart away construction debris, including the frequency with which this must be done
The total price, including materials, labor and any additional charges
The payment schedule. Any schedule of progress payments must bear a reasonable relationship to the work done, materials purchased or other project related costs
Supervise the progress of your project
This doesn’t mean you should stay with the crew every minute of the day. Just check on the progress of the project at the end of every work day to ensure the project goes as planned and conform to your agreement.
Keep a job file of important papers, including the contract, plans and specifications, warranties, advertisements, bills and invoices, canceled checks (front and back), correspondence and pictures of the job in progress.
Don’t be pressured into signing a Certificate of Completion until you’re certain that all work has been completed to your satisfaction and to the specifications set forth in the contract.
Don’t give your contractor the key to your house.
If you do your homework right and choose your contractor carefully, your home improvement project will be an experience to be enjoyed and not a nightmare.

## How to Choose a Houston Siding Company
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-to-choose-a-houston-siding-company/
Updated: 2024-12-24
Summary: Learn key tips on selecting the best Houston siding company for quality installation, durability, and expert service.

How to Choose a Houston Siding Company
Aug 26, 2019
Choosing a Houston siding company can be a little overwhelming. With so many options, how do you know what separates the best from the rest? Well, we believe that if you read these four easy tips, you’ll be well on your way to choosing the best Houston siding company.
1. Look for Reviews
Any high-quality Houston siding company should have plenty of reviews that are easily accessible to potential customers. Reading through customer reviews of different siding companies should give you a pretty good idea of the different companies’ quality of work. We trust that when you read our customer reviews that you’ll be very impressed.
2. Ask Company for References
Reading a customer review is one thing. However, being able to see the company’s work firsthand is ten times more helpful. When you’ve narrowed down your list to a few Houston siding companies, ask them for a list of customer references. When they give you their references, go check out the work they’ve done on those customer’s homes. When you see their work firsthand you will have a much clearer idea of who you can trust to install new and beautiful siding on your house.
3. Liability and Worker’s Compensation Insurance
Let’s play a game… Would you rather have to pay out of your own pocket for damages to your house caused by your siding company? Or would you rather be responsible for the medical bills of one of the siding company’s workers that was injured while working on your house? Wish you could answer ‘neither’? Well, you can. By making sure that your Houston siding company has liability and worker’s compensation insurance you can guarantee that you won’t have to live out either one of those scenarios.
4. Payment Options
Obviously you are going to have to pay for the new siding installed on your home. However, before choosing your Houston siding company, you should know if they provide different payment options. Here at Everest Siding and Windows, we offer a FlexPay finance option. Our FlexPay finance option allows customers to pay for their project in full, or just in part, by a low interest loan. Knowing the different payment options of a Houston siding company gives you more insight into which company will best fit your needs.
Once again, picking a Houston siding company can be difficult. But with these four tips it doesn’t have to be so challenging.
Give us a call today for a free estimate!

## How to Hang Holiday Lights on a Roof with Gutter Guards
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-to-hang-holiday-lights-on-a-roof-with-gutter-guards/
Updated: 2024-01-30
Summary: With the holidays coming up, you might be wondering how best to hang up your holiday lights and decorations.

How to Hang Holiday Lights on a Roof with Gutter Guards
Aug 26, 2019
With the holidays coming up, you might be wondering how best to hang up your holiday lights and decorations. Hanging Christmas lights on roofs with gutter guards can be a challenge because they can prevent certain kinds of light clips from properly attaching to your gutters. Rest easy, there are solutions.
The Right Clip Makes All the Difference
Gutter guards have a slit that is designed to let water runoff flow through which is about 3/8 of an inch wide. If the fastening portion of the clip can fit through the slit and hold to the front edge of the gutter, then your holiday lights can hang nicely. If you’d rather not mess with the slits, you can alternatively use adhesive light clips that sick directly to the front surface of your gutter. They are moisture resistant and strong enough to hold your lights in place without interfering with the flow of water runoff. They also can be installed in less time than traditional clips.
Attaching Lights to Shingles Instead of Gutters
If your gutter helmet is installed beneath your shingles, then most traditional shingle clips can be used by sliding the tab underneath the bottom shingle and then feeding the wire through the hanger. This will enable lights to be strung across the roofline. The one drawback to hanging lights like this is that if there is a heavy snowfall, your lights might be hidden from view.
Whichever way you choose to hang the lights, it is important to test all your strands of lights ahead of time to ensure that all the bulbs work. Once you’ve done that, plan and map out how you’re going to lay out the design of your lights. Measure the route for the lights to ensure you have enough strands before you start installing them and be mindful of where your electrical outlet to plug them all in is when drawing up your plan. Keep in mind that using shorter strands of lights makes it easier to identify and more cost effective to replace if they quit working.
Ask for help!
If you are unsure of what kind of clips work best with your gutters, don’t hesitate to contact Everest Siding And Windows for advice. We want you to be able to enjoy your holiday lights without worrying about damage to your gutter system. For more information about installing holiday lights, give us a call today.

## How to Keep a Sunroom Cool in Summer
URL: https://everestsidingandwindows.com/how-to-keep-a-sunroom-cool-in-summer/
Updated: 2024-12-24
Summary: Discover practical tips to keep your sunroom cool in summer, from smart shading to efficient ventilation and cooling solutions.

How to Keep a Sunroom Cool in Summer
Aug 15, 2024
A sunroom is a versatile addition to your house, it can fulfill various purposes such as a relaxation space, play room for kids, a gardening space or even a home office.
Your sunrooms should be the right temperature for utility purposes. Hence, designing a sunroom with adequate ventilation is optimal. In this blog, we will talk about some ways that can help you keep your sunroom cool in summer.
Make Sure Your Sunroom is Properly Insulated
A sunroom should be comfortable year-round, staying cool during the summer and warm during the winter. Proper insulation is key to achieving this balance. There can be many ways to make sure your sunroom is well insulated. Some of them include:
Using high quality insulation materials in the walls, ceilings and floors to keep cool air in during summers and prevent heat loss during winter.
Proper ventilation should allow adequate airflow. This will help regulate temperature and reduce air buildup.
Choosing the Right Sunroom Window
Choosing the right windows with features like double-triple glaze, tinting, low emissivity can reduce heat transfer. While the size depends on the client, they must be insulated well enough. You can also choose to install a retractable roof to manage direct sunlight.
Extend Your HVAC System
You must have an HVAC system running in your house. depending on its strength and your personal preference, you can expand you HVAC vents in your sunroom. This will integrate the entire system and allow its temperature to stay regulated just the same way as your house.
Use a Portable Cooling Device
If your technical aspects don’t allow a HVAC integration, you can install a separate AC in your sunroom. You can set an ideal temperature for your sunroom and turn it off when not in use. In order to make the choice, here are three types of AC systems you can choose from:
A ductless mini split AC
A window unit
A Portable AC
Install a Ceiling Fan
One very cheap yet extremely effective way to manage heat in your sunrooms is installing a ceiling fan. It can be used alongside AC or even on its own. Ceiling fans regulate air within your sunroom and are a more cost-effective solution to managing your needs.
Install Blinds in Your Sunroom
You can use a mixed approach to ensure that your sunroom remains cool when it is being used and even when it’s free. One way to ensure that is installing blinds in your sunroom. They will help you manage the levels of light and subsequent heat in the sunroom.
Try Window Tinting
We previously talked about properly insulated windows for maintaining the desired temperature in your sunroom. One other way is to go for tinted options. It reduces the likelihood of your room heating up. However, on downside to window tinting is it does now give you as much control like blinds or shades!
Overall Remarks
Sunrooms can be a great place to spend quality time with your family, friends and even alone. However, it should be comfortable with a desired temperature. You can keep your sunrooms cool by expanding your HVAC system, installing blinds, ceiling fans and proper insulation.
Consult our professionals at Everest Siding and Windows for impeccable sunroom construction and maintenance services. Call us at (832) 334-2528 .
